title: Walnut Stacking Moon and Stars
description: A compact wooden stacking toy for curious hands, made from smooth beechwood and finished with water-based, child-safe colors. The set includes a crescent moon and five chunky star rings in graduated sizes, designed to stack on the rounded peg or nest together for storage. Each piece is easy to grasp during supervised play, and the simple shapes invite color sorting and early size matching. The moon measures 6 inches tall and wipes clean with a damp cloth.

title: Pocket Weather Lab STEM Kit
description: Build a small weather station and track the conditions outside with this hands-on science kit for ages 8 and up. Contents include a plastic anemometer, rain gauge, wind vane, thermometer, reusable observation cards, and a 32-page illustrated guide. Kids assemble the instruments, place them in an open outdoor spot, and record wind direction, rainfall, and temperature over time. No batteries are needed; a household pencil and access to a window or yard are helpful for the activities.

title: Lanterns of Brindle Bay Board Game
description: Players work together to light a chain of harbor lanterns before a storm reaches the bay. This cooperative strategy game includes a folding board, 48 route tiles, four wooden boat tokens, storm markers, and a deck of event cards. For 2–4 players ages 10 and up, a typical game takes 35–50 minutes. Plan routes, share limited supplies, and adapt when the weather shifts. The box measures 10 by 10 inches and includes a quick-start sheet plus full rules.

title: Moss the Sleepy Axolotl Plush
description: Moss is a soft axolotl plush with muted sage fabric, embroidered gill details, and a gently weighted lower body that helps it sit on a shelf or bed. The outer fabric is polyester velour with polyester fiberfill; the eyes and smile are stitched rather than plastic. It measures 11 inches from nose to tail and is suitable for cuddling or imaginative play. Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap, then air dry. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Make-a-Miniature Paper Greenhouse Set
description: Create a tiny greenhouse scene with this paper craft set, featuring pre-cut cardstock walls, printed plant pots, translucent acetate panes, and peel-and-stick decorations. The finished model measures about 7 by 5 inches and includes a folding work mat, glue dots, and illustrated instructions. Young makers can color the plant labels and arrange the paper leaves before assembling the structure. Designed for ages 8 and up; scissors are not required, though an adult can help with the smaller folds.

title: Trailblazer Adjustable Backyard Kite
description: This lightweight diamond kite is made with a ripstop polyester sail, flexible fiberglass spars, and a braided polyester line with a comfortable wrist loop. Its adjustable tail helps young flyers steady the kite in a range of breezy conditions, while the bright orange and teal panels are easy to spot in the sky. The assembled kite measures 28 by 24 inches and packs into a drawstring storage sleeve. For outdoor use with adult supervision; fly in an open area away from roads and power lines.

title: Tidepool Tile Puzzle
description: Explore a busy rocky shore in this 500-piece puzzle illustrated with sea stars, anemones, tiny crabs, and tidepool plants. The pieces are cut from sturdy recycled greyboard with a matte, low-glare finish, and the box includes a full-size reference poster. When complete, the image measures 18 by 24 inches. A mix of edge and interior piece shapes keeps the build varied without relying on oversized pieces. Recommended for ages 10 and up; store the pieces in the included resealable bag.

title: Circuit Critter Rover Kit
description: Assemble a small rover that follows a dark line and changes direction when its front sensor meets an obstacle. The kit includes a snap-together chassis, two motors, wheels, a sensor board, screws, and a step-by-step illustrated manual. Kids can build the basic driving robot first, then adjust the sensor position to experiment with its responses. Recommended for ages 10 and up; a small Phillips screwdriver and four AA batteries are required but not included. The finished rover is about 6 inches long.

title: Replacement Wooden Pawns for Trail Town
description: A practical replacement set for players who have misplaced pieces from Trail Town or want spare markers for homemade board games. It contains eight unfinished beechwood pawns in four classic colors, with two pawns per color. Each piece stands approximately 1 inch tall and has a rounded top for easy handling. These are loose game components rather than a complete game, and no board, cards, or rules are included. Keep small pieces away from children under 3 years old.

title: Scribble Dock USB Drawing Tablet
description: Give doodles a reusable home with this slim LCD drawing tablet, designed for sketches, lists, and simple tracing practice. The 10-inch pressure-sensitive screen responds to the included stylus, and a front button clears the display for a fresh start. A lock switch helps prevent accidental erasing when carrying it in a backpack. The lightweight ABS case measures 10.5 by 6.5 inches and includes a replaceable coin-cell battery installed. Suitable for ages 6 and up; this is a drawing surface, not a full-color screen or app-connected device.

title: Cedarwood Shape Sorter Pull-Along Wagon
description: A sturdy pull-along wagon that doubles as a first shape sorter, made from smooth, water-based-finish beechwood. Four chunky blocks fit through matching openings in the wagon sides, giving little hands a simple way to practice grasping and matching. The cotton pull cord is 60 cm long, and the wagon measures 22 × 14 × 12 cm. Blocks lift out through the open top for easy reset. Designed for supervised play from 18 months; wipe clean with a damp cloth.

title: Build a Biome: Desert Greenhouse STEM Kit
description: Explore how plants conserve water with a tabletop desert greenhouse kit for curious builders ages 8 and up. Assemble the clear PET enclosure, connect its vent panels, and plant the included fast-sprouting seeds in two coir growing plugs. A printed experiment journal guides observations of condensation, light, and soil moisture over two weeks. The finished greenhouse measures 20 × 15 × 18 cm and includes reusable parts, a pipette, and illustrated instructions. Adult help is recommended for setup and seed care.

title: Night Market Noodle Shop Board Game
description: Run a lively noodle stall in this family strategy game for two to four players, ages 10 and up. Collect ingredient cards, fulfill customer orders, and upgrade your cart before the night market closes. Each round brings a changing menu, so players must balance quick sales with saving rare toppings for bigger orders. The box includes a foldout market board, 96 cards, 40 wooden ingredient tokens, four player screens, and a rulebook. A typical game takes 35–45 minutes.

title: Pebble the Rainy-Day Capybara Plush
description: Pebble is a soft, round capybara companion with embroidered eyes, a tiny rust-colored rain hat, and a weighted base that helps it sit on a shelf or bed. The outer fabric is recycled polyester plush, with polyester fiberfill inside and no hard plastic features. It measures 25 cm from nose to rump, a cozy size for reading corners and travel bags. Spot clean gently and air dry. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Pressed Leaf Sun Catcher Craft Box
description: Make four colorful window decorations with this nature-inspired sun catcher craft box. Children layer translucent tissue shapes between clear, pre-cut film panels, then finish each design with paper frames and hanging cord. The kit includes four 12 cm panels, 20 tissue sheets, two lengths of cotton cord, adhesive dots, and a simple picture guide. No scissors or liquid glue are required, though younger makers may appreciate help arranging small pieces. Suitable for ages 6 and up; finished pieces are for indoor windows.

title: Sprout-Step Garden Stilt Set
description: Bring balance practice outdoors with a pair of sturdy garden stilts sized for growing kids. Each stilt has a broad, textured polypropylene foot platform and an adjustable nylon hand strap that can be set to three positions. The lightweight design is easy to carry to the park or backyard, while the wide base helps beginners find their footing on flat ground. Each stilt measures 18 cm tall and supports up to 45 kg. Use on a clear, level surface with adult supervision; recommended for ages 6 and up.

title: Moonlit Greenhouse 500-Piece Puzzle
description: Piece together a glasshouse glowing under a crescent moon, filled with climbing vines, potted herbs, and warm amber windows. This 500-piece jigsaw is printed on sturdy recycled board with a matte finish to reduce glare during longer puzzle sessions. The completed image measures 48 × 34 cm, and the box includes a full-size reference poster. Pieces are precision cut and vary in shape for a satisfying challenge. Recommended for ages 10 and up; store completed or loose pieces in the reusable box.

title: Glow Code Pixel Creature Kit
description: Build a small programmable pixel creature and give it animations, expressions, and simple light-based reactions. The kit includes a low-voltage control board, a 16 × 16 LED matrix, USB cable, snap-fit enclosure, and beginner-friendly coding activities that work through a browser-based block editor. Kids can customize scrolling icons and create a basic response to changing light levels. The assembled toy is about 10 cm tall and runs from USB power, not included. Recommended for ages 10 and up, with adult assistance for initial setup.

title: First Garden Wooden Threading Beads
description: A tactile threading set featuring large wooden beads shaped like a tomato, carrot, watering can, leaf, and sun. Each piece is sanded smooth and finished with child-safe water-based colors, with openings sized for the included thick cotton lace. The set contains 10 beads and two 60 cm laces with firm plastic-free ends, stored in a cotton drawstring bag. Beads measure about 4–5 cm across. Designed to encourage hand-eye coordination during supervised play from age 3; keep away from children under 3 due to small parts.

title: Fold-and-Fly Foam Glider Workshop
description: Design, decorate, and test three lightweight gliders with this hands-on outdoor flight set. Each foam body folds into place without tools, while removable tail pieces let kids compare how different shapes affect the flight path. The kit includes three gliders, washable marker stickers, a simple launch guide, and a measuring tape for backyard distance challenges. Finished gliders span about 32 cm and are intended for open outdoor spaces away from roads and power lines. Recommended for ages 7 and up; adult supervision is advised during flight play.

title: Pocket Soundscape Recorder
description: Capture everyday sounds and turn them into a mini listening library with this kid-friendly portable recorder. A built-in microphone records short clips to internal memory, and the simple buttons make it easy to play, pause, and replay without menus. The recorder includes a USB-C charging cable, a soft wrist loop, and a quick-start booklet with sound scavenger-hunt prompts. Its compact ABS case measures 9 × 5 cm and has a 3.5 mm headphone jack for private listening. Recommended for ages 8 and up; headphones and wall adapter sold separately.

title: Little Harbor Silicone Bath Boats
description: Make bath time a small harbor adventure with four soft silicone boats that float, scoop, and link together. Each boat measures about 4 inches long and has rounded edges sized for little hands. The food-grade silicone is flexible, easy to rinse, and dries quickly when separated. Boats come in muted sea-glass colors and nest together for compact storage. Suitable for supervised water play, they encourage pouring, stacking, and simple pretend play from the tub to the water table.

title: Backyard Birdsong Decoder Kit
description: Explore how birds use sound with a hands-on listening and pattern-matching kit for curious junior naturalists. The set includes a pocket sound tube, a reusable field notebook, six illustrated bird cards, and a simple guide to comparing pitch and rhythm. Kids can listen outdoors, sketch what they notice, and sort calls by their patterns. The lightweight tools fit in a daypack, and the activities work in a backyard or park. Recommended for ages 8 and up; adult help is useful for the first outing.

title: The Clockwork Bakery Cooperative
description: Players run tiny mechanical bakeries, collecting ingredient gears and coordinating orders before the town's morning bell. In this cooperative game for 1–4 players, each turn offers a choice between repairing a machine, preparing a pastry, or helping a neighbor finish a delivery. The illustrated board, chunky wooden gear tokens, cards, and easy-to-follow rulebook are designed for family game nights. A session takes about 30 minutes, with enough changing orders to make each bakery shift feel a little different. Suggested for ages 8 and up.

title: Pippin the Pocket-Sized Cloud Sheep
description: Pippin is a palm-sized sheep plush with a fluffy cream fleece, a soft gray face, and embroidered sleepy eyes. Measuring 7 inches from hoof to head, this little companion fits neatly into a backpack pocket or beside a pillow. Its outer fabric is a polyester blend with soft fiber filling, and the securely stitched details avoid hard accessories. Pippin is ready for quiet reading, travel, or imaginative farm play. Surface clean with a damp cloth and mild soap; allow to air dry fully.

title: Color-Shift Window Mosaic Sheets
description: Create bright window designs without glue or scissors using a set of translucent, repositionable mosaic sheets. The kit contains 120 pre-cut shapes in jewel tones, two clear design panels, and a pattern booklet with simple geometric and nature-inspired layouts. Children can arrange the pieces on a clean, smooth window, then peel them off and try a new composition. The sheets let daylight shine through while adding color to a playroom or bedroom. Designed for ages 5 and up; adult supervision is recommended around windows.

title: Creekside Bug Viewer Adventure Set
description: Take a closer look at garden visitors with a sturdy bug viewer made for supervised outdoor exploration. The clear-sided container includes a ventilated lid, a removable magnifying top, and a fold-out handle for carrying on short walks. Also included are a soft-bristle observation brush and a waterproof picture card showing common backyard insects. The viewer is approximately 6 inches tall and opens easily for catch-and-release discoveries. Use it with an adult, keep observations brief, and return living creatures gently to where they were found.

title: Paper Planets: Solar System Jigsaw
description: Assemble a colorful 300-piece illustration of the solar system, with planets, moons, and labeled orbital paths set against a deep navy sky. The finished puzzle measures 18 by 24 inches and is printed on thick recycled board with a matte finish that helps reduce glare. A full-size reference poster is included for sorting and checking progress. Pieces are shaped for older children and adults to enjoy together, making this a relaxed evening activity for space fans ages 8 and up.

title: TinkerTone Modular Music Tiles
description: Build short electronic melodies by snapping together colorful sound tiles and arranging them in a sequence. This beginner-friendly set includes eight rechargeable tiles, a USB-C charging cable, and a foldout guide to rhythm, pitch, and simple patterns. Each tile plays a distinct tone or beat when activated, so kids can experiment with loops without needing a screen or prior music experience. The compact pieces store in a cotton drawstring pouch. Recommended for ages 9 and up; charge with the included cable before first use.

title: Rainy Day Felt Story Garden
description: Make a soft, reusable garden scene with this beginner sewing and storytelling set. It includes pre-punched felt pieces for a flower bed, three vegetables, two bees, and a watering can, plus blunt plastic needles, embroidery thread, and a felt display board. Children can stitch with simple running stitches, then rearrange the characters to invent new garden stories. Finished pieces range from 2 to 5 inches tall. Designed for ages 7 and up, with adult guidance recommended for threading and early sewing steps.

title: Mini Marble Run: Magnetic Bridge Builder
description: Design a tabletop marble course using magnetic panels, ramps, and supports that snap together for quick rebuilding. The 42-piece kit includes translucent construction pieces, three glass marbles, and challenge cards that introduce height, turns, and basic cause-and-effect ideas. Build on a refrigerator-safe steel board or the included compact base, then test how changes to the path affect the marble's movement. Pieces pack into a lidded storage tray. Recommended for ages 8 and up; not intended for children under 3.

title: Little Orchard Wooden Fruit Lacing Set
description: Introduce little hands to threading and pretend play with a set of chunky wooden orchard fruits. The six pieces include an apple, pear, plum, peach, lemon, and strawberry, each with a smooth hole for the included cotton lace. Fruits are made from solid beechwood and finished with water-based colors; the lace has a rounded wooden tip for easier handling. Designed for supervised play, the set comes in a compact cotton drawstring bag and suits toddlers practicing hand-eye coordination and naming familiar foods.

title: Pocket Planetarium: Build a Star Projector
description: Build a tabletop star projector and explore how light, rotation, and simple gears work together. The kit includes a pre-cut cardboard housing, a small motor, battery holder, LED, printed star discs, and illustrated assembly instructions. Once assembled, the projector turns a disc to cast constellation patterns onto a nearby wall or ceiling in a dim room. It is designed for ages 9 and up, with basic wiring and a few small components that may need help from an adult. Requires two AA batteries, sold separately.

title: Maple Street Mystery Board Game
description: Work together to solve a neighborhood mystery before the evening bell rings. Players move through a illustrated town map, gather clues from local shops, and compare evidence cards to uncover which keepsake has gone missing. The game includes a folding board, 60 clue and character cards, wooden player markers, a six-sided die, and a case booklet with multiple solutions for repeat play. Suitable for 2–5 players ages 8 and up, a typical game takes about 30 minutes. Clear turns and shared decisions make it a good fit for family game night.

title: Tumbleberry the Velvet Mushroom Plush
description: Tumbleberry is a squat little mushroom plush with a rust-red cap, embroidered cream spots, and a soft moss-green base. Its velvety polyester fabric and lightly padded shape make it comfortable to tuck beside a pillow or carry along on quiet outings. The plush measures about 8 inches tall and has embroidered facial details, with no hard accessories or loose plastic parts. Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap, then air dry. A cheerful woodland companion for younger kids, collectors, or anyone building a cozy shelf of forest friends.

title: Color Lab: Scratchboard Creature Cards
description: Reveal bright colors beneath a dark surface with this scratchboard drawing set. It includes 20 coated cards featuring simple creature outlines, a wooden stylus, and a small practice sheet for testing patterns and line styles. Kids can scratch in the printed designs or invent their own scales, feathers, and stripes, then display finished cards on a bedroom shelf or share them with friends. The compact box is easy to pack for travel and works well for ages 6 and up. Use the stylus with care and keep the set on a protected surface.

title: Canyon Creek Junior Archery Set
description: Practice aim outdoors with a beginner-friendly foam archery set made for supervised play. The kit contains a lightweight plastic bow, three soft-tipped arrows, and a freestanding target with printed scoring rings. The bow measures 27 inches and is sized for children learning basic coordination rather than competitive shooting. Set the target on level ground in a clear area, keep bystanders behind the archer, and use only the included arrows. Recommended for ages 8 and up with adult supervision. The target folds flat for storage between backyard sessions or trips to the park.

title: Tessellating Turtles 300-Piece Puzzle
description: Assemble a colorful pond scene filled with turtles, lily pads, reeds, and small water insects. This 300-piece jigsaw uses sturdy recycled board with a matte finish to reduce glare while sorting and building. The finished image measures 18 by 12 inches, a manageable size for a kitchen table or puzzle mat. Pieces are cut in varied shapes to keep the experience engaging for older children and casual puzzlers. A full-color reference image is included in the box, which is made from paperboard and stores the pieces between sessions.

title: Beat Builder Pocket Rhythm Sequencer
description: Create short electronic rhythms with a pocket-sized sequencer made for curious music makers. The unit has 16 illuminated pads, built-in speaker, headphone jack, and simple controls for tempo, volume, and saving up to four patterns. Kids can tap in beats, layer percussion sounds, and switch between preset kits without connecting to a computer. A USB-C cable is included for charging; headphones are not included. The 4.5-inch plastic-and-electronics device is recommended for ages 10 and up and fits easily in a backpack for music experiments at home or on the go.

title: Cloudberry Counting Cups
description: Stack, nest, scoop, and count with a set of eight graduated cups in soft, muted colors. Made from durable food-grade silicone, the cups have rounded rims and drainage holes that make them useful at bath time as well as on a play mat. Each cup is marked with a simple number and matching dot count, giving toddlers a playful way to explore size and early counting. The largest cup is about 3.5 inches wide, and all eight nest together for tidy storage. Rinse after use and allow the cups to dry fully.

title: Backyard Weather Station Builder
description: Assemble a small outdoor weather station and track changes in wind direction, rainfall, and temperature. The kit includes a wooden mounting frame, plastic rain gauge, wind vane parts, analog thermometer, fasteners, and a weather logbook with observation prompts. No batteries or wiring are required; children build the instruments with basic tools and place the finished station in a sheltered outdoor spot. Recommended for ages 10 and up, with adult assistance for mounting and reading the thermometer. The components are designed for seasonal outdoor use and should be brought inside during severe weather.

title: Enamel Pin Studio: Make-and-Trade Badges
description: Design a set of small wearable badges with this beginner-friendly pin-making kit. It includes 12 blank metal pin backs, shrink film sheets, colored pencils, a fine-line marker, and a guide with templates for animals, symbols, and custom designs. Draw and color each badge, then ask an adult to use a household oven to shrink the artwork before attaching it to the pin back. Finished pins are about 1 to 1.5 inches wide, depending on the design. Recommended for ages 10 and up; adult help is required for heating and assembly.

title: Bamboo Teething Ring with Cotton Crinkle Leaf
description: Give little hands something easy to grasp with this smooth bamboo teething ring, paired with a soft cotton leaf that crinkles when squeezed. The ring measures 3.5 inches across and has rounded edges sized for supervised play and teething comfort. The removable leaf is made from printed cotton with a gentle rustle layer inside, so babies can explore different textures and sounds. Wipe the wooden ring with a damp cloth and machine-wash the leaf on a gentle cycle.

title: Backyard Waterwheel Engineering Lab
description: Build a working waterwheel and test how blade shape affects its spin with this hands-on engineering kit for ages 8 and up. The set includes laser-cut plywood pieces, a sturdy frame, a small collection basin, connectors, and an illustrated experiment guide. Assemble the wheel with basic tools, then pour water over it to explore motion, force, and simple machines. Three interchangeable blade designs make it easy to compare results and record observations at a sink or outdoor table.

title: Campfire Stories Cooperative Card Game
description: Work together to weave a funny campfire tale before the night-sky cards run out. Players draw character, setting, and surprise cards, then add a sentence to the group story while meeting playful prompts along the way. The compact box contains 96 cards, a wooden campfire token, and a foldout rules sheet for 2–6 players ages 7 and up. A round takes about 20 minutes, making it an easy choice for family evenings, travel, or a cabin weekend.

title: Juniper the Patchwork Garden Snail Plush
description: Juniper is a soft garden snail with a moss-green body, embroidered freckles, and a quilt-style shell made from cotton-blend fabric panels. The plush measures 11 inches from feelers to tail and is filled with recycled polyester for a squeezable, lightweight feel. Satin-stitched details keep the face friendly without hard parts, while the shell makes a cozy spot for imaginative garden adventures. Surface wash with a damp cloth and mild soap; recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Folded Paper Lantern Animal Craft Pack
description: Turn colorful sheets into a small parade of glowing paper animals with this beginner-friendly craft pack. It includes 12 pre-cut lantern templates, tissue inserts, adhesive tabs, cotton hanging loops, and step-by-step instructions for making foxes, owls, and rabbits. Each finished lantern is about 6 inches tall and can be displayed with a battery-operated tea light (not included). The folding and decorating activities suit ages 7 and up, with adult help recommended for younger crafters.

title: Junior Creekside Casting Net Set
description: Encourage careful creekside exploration with a child-sized casting net designed for observing small aquatic life and returning it gently to the water. The set includes a 30-inch telescoping handle, a fine mesh hoop net, a clear viewing tray, and a waterproof field card for noting discoveries. The lightweight handle adjusts for easier storage and use by young explorers ages 6 and up. Use with adult supervision, avoid handling wildlife, and rinse the mesh with fresh water after each outing.

title: The Tiny Train Station 200-Piece Puzzle
description: Piece together a bustling little station where striped cats, parcels, and a red locomotive share the platform. This 200-piece puzzle features a detailed original illustration printed on thick recycled board with a matte finish to reduce glare. When complete, the scene measures 14 by 10 inches, a manageable size for younger puzzlers or a relaxed family activity. The box includes a full-color reference image and a resealable paper bag for storing pieces between sessions. Suggested for ages 7 and up.

title: Pocket Arcade Handheld Logic Console
description: A pocket-sized handheld for quick logic challenges, pattern matching, and number games, with no internet connection or account required. The console has a 2.4-inch color screen, four tactile control buttons, adjustable volume, and a rechargeable battery that charges by USB-C. It comes with 30 built-in puzzles across three difficulty levels and a soft wrist strap for travel. The compact body measures 5 inches tall and is recommended for ages 8 and up; a charging cable is included.

title: AA Alkaline Batteries, Four-Pack
description: Keep compatible toys and household gadgets running with this practical four-pack of AA alkaline batteries. Each battery is labeled with its polarity and comes ready to use in standard AA-powered devices such as flashlights, remotes, and select electronic toys. Store the pack in a cool, dry place and check the device manual before replacing batteries. This straightforward refill is useful to keep in a craft drawer or toy cupboard, though it is best suited to practical restocking rather than a special-occasion gift.

title: Replacement Wooden Fish Tokens for Reef Rescue
description: Replace misplaced or damaged pieces from Reef Rescue with this set of six unfinished wooden fish tokens. Each token measures approximately 1.25 inches long and is cut from smooth, lightweight birch with rounded edges. The set includes two orange, two teal, and two natural-finish fish, each marked with a simple painted eye for easy identification during play. These are spare game components, not a standalone toy or game; check that your edition uses the matching fish shape before ordering.

title: Birchwood Nesting Rainbow Arch Set
description: A set of six smooth, graduated wooden arches for stacking, nesting, and building imaginative tunnels. Each piece is made from solid birch with water-based color finishes and gently rounded edges. The largest arch measures 7 inches wide, sized for small hands to carry and arrange. Babies can explore the shapes with a grown-up nearby, while toddlers use them for sorting and open-ended play. Wipe clean with a damp cloth and dry promptly; intended for supervised play.

title: Junior Magnetic Levitation Lab
description: Explore magnetic forces with a hands-on kit for building a small levitating display and testing how magnets interact. The box includes a lightweight frame, magnetic components, a clear base, experiment cards, and an illustrated guide with six activities. Assemble the setup on a level table, then try changing the spacing and orientation of the magnets to observe what happens. Designed for ages 10 and up; adult help is recommended during assembly. Small parts are included.

title: Maplewood Market Day
description: Players take turns visiting a bustling neighborhood market, collecting ingredient cards, and completing recipe orders before the stalls close. This family strategy game includes a folding board, 96 illustrated cards, wooden produce tokens, four player pawns, and a rulebook. A typical game takes about 30 minutes for two to four players, ages 8 and up. Simple turn choices make it approachable for newer players, while changing orders give repeat games a fresh mix of goals.

title: Nori the Moon Jelly Plush
description: Nori is a squishy moon jellyfish plush with a velvety blue body, embroidered sleepy eyes, and eight soft fabric tentacles. The body is filled with polyester fiber and measures about 10 inches across; the trailing tentacles add another 7 inches of length. A small woven loop makes it easy to hang from a bedroom hook when not in use. Surface clean with a damp cloth and mild soap, then air dry. Suitable for cuddling and imaginative sea-life play.

title: Printmaker's Garden Stamp Kit
description: Make repeating garden scenes with this beginner-friendly block-printing set. It includes six soft-grip foam stamps, two washable ink pads, a practice sheet, and 20 sheets of uncoated paper in assorted sizes. Press a stamp into the ink, then transfer the pattern onto cards, journal pages, or handmade gift wrap. The stamps feature leaves, seed pods, and small flowers for mixing into larger designs. Recommended for ages 6 and up; protect work surfaces and wash hands after crafting.

title: Creekside Balance Disc Course
description: Turn a lawn or playroom into a simple movement course with five textured balance discs and two connecting planks. The discs are made from durable, weather-resistant plastic with non-slip tops, while the lightweight planks have molded grip ridges. Arrange the pieces in a straight path or spread them apart for stepping challenges. Each disc is 9 inches across; the set stores compactly when stacked. Intended for children ages 5 and up, with adult supervision on a clear, level surface.

title: The Lighthouse Keeper's 300-Piece Puzzle
description: Piece together a windswept coastal scene featuring a lighthouse, rocky shore, and a small fishing boat returning at dusk. The 300 thick cardboard pieces have a matte finish to reduce glare and are cut in a variety of shapes for a satisfying build. The completed image measures 18 by 24 inches, and a full-color reference poster is included. Packaged in a sturdy box for storage between sessions, this puzzle is suited to ages 8 and up and can be assembled solo or with family.

title: Pocket Circuit Lab: Light-Up Badge Maker
description: Build a wearable light-up badge while learning the basics of a simple circuit. The kit includes a reusable snap-together circuit board, LED module, battery holder, conductive fasteners, blank badge shapes, and illustrated instructions. Try different component arrangements to make the light switch on, then decorate the badge with the included stickers and markers. No soldering is required. Designed for ages 9 and up; the kit requires two AAA batteries, sold separately, and includes small parts.

title: Soft Clay Creature Studio
description: Shape a cast of tiny desk-friendly creatures with this air-dry clay craft set. Contents include four colors of lightweight clay, a child-safe shaping tool, two texture rollers, and a booklet with step-by-step projects for making a frog, snail, and original characters. Finished pieces dry firm when left uncovered, so no oven is needed. The clay comes in resealable tubs to help keep unused portions workable. Recommended for ages 7 and up; protect clothing and surfaces while crafting.

title: Glow Trail Backyard Ring Toss
description: Bring a familiar tossing game outside with a sturdy target post and six flexible rings in three bright colors. The post breaks into sections for storage and can be pushed into soft ground using its broad base. Glow accents on the rings make them easier to spot as the evening light fades, while the printed score guide offers simple solo and team challenges. Set the throwing line at a distance that suits the players. Recommended for ages 6 and up; use in an open area.

title: Pocket Choir: Record-and-Remix Keyboard
description: This compact, battery-powered keyboard lets young musicians layer short recordings over simple beats. It features 25 mini keys, eight instrument tones, built-in rhythm patterns, a microphone, and a loop function for recording and replaying phrases. The lightweight body measures 15 inches wide and includes a small speaker plus a headphone jack for quieter practice. Use it on a desk or carry it along to lessons and playdates. Suitable for ages 8 and up; requires four AA batteries, sold separately.

title: Rainforest Tummy-Time Mirror Mat
description: Give curious babies a soft place to stretch, roll, and explore. This quilted tummy-time mat pairs a cotton outer cover with a wipe-clean backing and a baby-safe, shatter-resistant mirror that attaches with fabric ties. Four textured leaf patches invite little hands to pat and grasp. The mat measures 30 by 30 inches and folds in half for storage or travel. Use it on a flat floor under adult supervision; remove the mirror before machine-washing the cover.

title: Pocket Greenhouse: Crystal Growing Lab
description: Explore crystal growth with a compact countertop lab designed for curious makers ages 8 and up. The kit includes a clear observation chamber, seed crystals, measuring scoop, stirring stick, three color tablets, and illustrated instructions for two growth experiments. Young scientists mix the supplied materials with warm water and check their crystals over several days, recording changes in the included observation journal. Adult help is recommended for preparing the solution. The reusable chamber measures 5 inches tall and is intended for indoor use.

title: Foxglove Crossing: A Woodland Strategy Game
description: Plan a winding route through the woods in this family strategy game for two to four players, ages 8 and up. Players place path tiles, collect berry tokens, and guide their wooden fox toward a shared clearing while adapting to changing trail cards. A typical game takes about 30 minutes. The box contains 64 illustrated cardboard tiles, four wooden fox pieces, 40 tokens, a card deck, and a rulebook. Its approachable turns suit family game nights, with enough route planning to keep repeat plays lively.

title: Bramble the Striped Garden Dormouse
description: Bramble is a cuddly dormouse plush with a warm cream belly, soft rust-and-brown stripes, and tiny embroidered paws. The 10-inch toy is made from short-pile polyester plush with recycled polyester filling, and its facial details are stitched rather than attached. A weighted base helps Bramble sit upright on a bedside shelf or join make-believe woodland adventures. Spot-clean with a damp cloth and mild soap, then air-dry. Suitable for ages 3 and up; not designed as a sleep product for infants.

title: Print Your Own Creature Patch Kit
description: Make a small collection of iron-on creature patches using foam stamps, fabric ink, and washable cotton squares. This kit includes six blank 3-by-3-inch cotton pieces, four animal-shaped foam stamps, two washable ink pads, a practice sheet, and clear instructions for setting the finished designs with adult help. Kids can combine prints to create badges for a backpack, pencil case, or fabric notebook cover. The kit is intended for ages 7 and up. Test ink on an inconspicuous fabric area before applying patches to clothing.

title: Puddle Jumper Step-and-Splash Stones
description: Set up a wobbly stepping path for backyard balance games, obstacle courses, and imaginative puddle-hopping missions. The set includes six molded polypropylene stones in three heights, each with a textured top and a broad, non-slip base. Arrange them close together for beginners or farther apart as balance improves. Each stone supports up to 110 pounds and nests with the others for compact storage. For outdoor use on level grass or a dry patio; adult supervision is recommended, and stones should be brought indoors after play.

title: Undersea Window Scene 150-Piece Puzzle
description: Piece together a bright underwater scene of seahorses, kelp, and a curious octopus in this 150-piece puzzle. Designed for ages 6 and up, it uses sturdy recycled cardboard pieces with a matte finish to reduce glare while puzzling. The completed image measures 12 by 9 inches, making it easy to display on a desk or frame for a bedroom wall. A full-color reference image is included inside the box. The medium-sized pieces are shaped for younger puzzlers building confidence with longer projects.

title: SnapShot Junior Instant Print Camera
description: A kid-friendly instant print camera for capturing playdates, pets, and everyday discoveries without ink cartridges. The camera prints black-and-white thermal images on supplied paper rolls and includes a rechargeable battery, USB-C charging cable, wrist strap, and three rolls of paper. Its 2.4-inch color screen supports photo and short-video modes, while a simple menu keeps settings easy to find. The body measures 4.5 inches across and fits comfortably in smaller hands. Recommended for ages 8 and up; adult guidance is advised when loading paper.

title: Woodland First Sounds Pull-Along Cart
description: A sturdy wooden pull-along cart introduces little walkers to movement, color, and gentle sound. The beechwood body carries three removable animal blocks—a rabbit, fox, and hedgehog—each with rounded edges and water-based painted details. As the cart rolls, a row of enclosed wooden beads makes a soft rattle. It measures 8 inches long and comes with a 24-inch cotton pull cord. Intended for children ages 18 months and up; use under adult supervision and inspect the cord and wheels regularly.

title: Backyard Solar Bug Observatory
description: Build a small solar-powered observation station and learn how light can power a motor. The kit includes a snap-together housing, mini solar panel, low-voltage motor, clear bug-viewing chamber, plastic gears, and a picture-led guide with three build configurations. No soldering is required, and the transparent chamber has ventilation slots for brief, supervised observations before insects are released outdoors. The assembled station is about 7 inches tall. Recommended for ages 10 and up; best results come from a bright outdoor location and adult assistance with assembly.

title: Cotton Candy Labyrinth Marble Game
description: Guide a marble through a colorful tabletop labyrinth by tilting the board and choosing when to open its sliding gates. This solo or cooperative challenge game includes a wood-fiber board with a clear acrylic cover, one steel marble, and 24 route cards ranging from beginner to tricky. Players can race against a timer or take turns completing a route together. The board measures 9 by 9 inches and stores the marble in a built-in compartment. Suitable for ages 7 and up; play on a level surface.

title: Little Acorn Wooden Push-Car Set
description: Made for small hands and early adventures, this set includes two sturdy wooden push cars with smooth, rounded edges and water-based color accents. Each car measures about 4 inches long, making them easy to grasp, roll, and carry from room to room. The wheels turn freely across flat floors, encouraging toddlers to practice reaching, grasping, and chasing. A simple, screen-free play choice for everyday discovery, the cars arrive ready to play and wipe clean with a damp cloth.

title: Bridge Builder: Mini Span Engineering Kit
description: Explore how triangles and beams help a bridge hold weight with this hands-on engineering kit for curious builders. It includes 48 laser-cut plywood pieces, connector pegs, a small test platform, and illustrated instructions for three bridge designs. Assemble each span, then test it with the included wooden load blocks and compare results. Designed for ages 8 and up, the kit offers an approachable introduction to structures, balance, and iterative problem-solving. A screwdriver is not required.

title: The Case of the Missing Mooncake
description: Gather clues, share theories, and solve a neighborhood mystery in this cooperative deduction game for 2–5 players. The box includes a fold-out street map, 60 clue cards, wooden player markers, and a case file booklet with several cases to revisit. Players take turns questioning characters and connecting details before the bakery closes for the night. A typical round takes 25–35 minutes, making it a good fit for family game night or a small group of young sleuths.

title: Marmalade the Sleepy Red Panda Plush
description: Marmalade is a cuddly red panda plush with rust-colored velour fur, cream face markings, and a soft striped tail. Measuring 12 inches from nose to tail, this huggable companion is sized for bedtime snuggles, reading corners, and imaginative play. The plush is filled with resilient polyester fiber and has embroidered eyes and nose, with no hard plastic details. Spot clean gently and air dry. A sweet animal-themed gift for kids who love woodland wildlife.

title: Painted Pebble Garden Critters Kit
description: Turn smooth river pebbles into tiny garden visitors with this beginner-friendly painting set. It contains 12 assorted natural stones, six washable acrylic paint pots, two brushes, adhesive felt dots, and a picture guide with ideas for beetles, frogs, and ladybugs. Kids can paint, let the designs dry, then add the felt dots to help the finished critters sit securely on a shelf or windowsill. Best used with adult supervision and a covered work surface; stones vary in shape and size.

title: Trail Tumble Junior Slackline Kit
description: Set up a low, beginner-friendly balance line between two sturdy trees with this junior slackline kit. The 30-foot polyester webbing has a grippy woven surface, and the included ratchet and protective tree sleeves help create a secure setup when installed according to the instructions. A removable practice line gives new users a handhold as they learn to balance. Designed for outdoor use with adult setup and close supervision; always check the anchor points and clear the area before play.

title: Coastal Cottage Windows 250-Piece Puzzle
description: Piece together a breezy seaside scene of pastel cottages, flower boxes, and a winding path down to the water. This 250-piece jigsaw is printed on sturdy recycled board with a matte finish that helps reduce glare during longer puzzle sessions. When complete, the image measures 15 by 11 inches. The box includes a full-color reference poster and a resealable bag for storing pieces between sessions. A satisfying challenge for older kids, teens, or anyone who enjoys bright coastal artwork.

title: Pocket Synth Sound Explorer
description: Make and shape electronic sounds with this compact pocket synthesizer built for young music explorers. The unit features touch-sensitive note pads, four sound modes, a simple loop recorder, and a built-in speaker, with a headphone jack for quieter sessions. A USB-C cable is included for charging and connecting to a computer for audio output; headphones are sold separately. Its durable plastic shell measures about 5 inches across, so it fits easily in a backpack for travel or after-school jam sessions.

title: Soft Start Fabric Sensory Blocks
description: This set of six lightweight fabric blocks gives babies a gentle way to explore color, texture, and sound. Each 3-inch cube is sewn from cotton and soft-touch polyester fabrics, with crinkle material, a quiet bell, and varied tactile panels tucked inside the set. Bright stitched details make the blocks easy to spot during floor play, while their soft construction suits stacking and gentle tossing. Machine wash on a delicate cycle in a laundry bag and air dry. Suitable for supervised play from 6 months.

title: Build-a-Bug Solar Spinner Workshop
description: Build a small garden spinner and discover how sunlight can power a moving mechanism. The kit includes a miniature solar panel, a motor, a reusable plastic chassis, colored spinner blades, and illustrated assembly instructions. Once built, place the spinner in direct sunlight and watch the blades turn; no batteries are needed. Kids can try different blade arrangements and compare how the spinner behaves. Recommended for ages 8 and up, with adult help suggested for younger builders during assembly.

title: Backyard Bubble Lab Wand Set
description: Experiment with giant bubbles using a set of three differently shaped wands and a wide mixing tray. The kit includes a cotton loop wand, a double-ring wand, a star-shaped wand, and a recipe card for mixing bubble solution from common household ingredients. Each wand has a smooth plastic handle sized for kids, while the flexible loops create bubbles of different shapes and sizes. Use outdoors on a calm day, rinse the wands after play, and store them dry in the included mesh bag.

title: Little Loom Wooden Bead Maze
description: This compact wooden bead maze gives little hands a satisfying route to explore. Smooth beechwood tracks hold three brightly colored beads that slide and loop around a sturdy base, encouraging grasping and early hand-eye coordination. It measures 6.5 inches across and stands 5 inches tall, a manageable size for a play mat or low table. Made with water-based finishes, it wipes clean with a damp cloth. Designed for supervised play, it makes a cheerful addition to a toddler’s activity shelf.

title: Kitchen Chemistry: Foaming Fountain Lab
description: Turn a kitchen-table experiment into a colorful bubbling fountain with this beginner chemistry kit. It includes reusable reaction cups, a measuring spoon, safety goggles, a washable tray, and illustrated instructions for six demonstrations using common household ingredients. Kids can test how changing amounts affects the foam and record their observations in the included lab notebook. The setup is intended for ages eight and up, with an adult nearby for mixing and cleanup. No batteries are required; vinegar and baking soda are not included.

title: Lanterns of Driftwood Bay
description: In this cooperative strategy game, players work together to guide fishing boats into a sheltered harbor before a shifting storm arrives. Each turn offers a choice between moving a boat, collecting lantern fuel, or changing the tide cards that shape the board. The game includes a fold-out coastal map, wooden boat markers, weather cards, and a compact rulebook. A round takes about 30 minutes and supports two to four players ages ten and up. It rewards planning and communication without eliminating players from the action.

title: Miso the Toasted Marshmallow Otter
description: Miso is a palm-sized otter plush with a warm cream belly, cocoa-brown velour back, and a stitched little smile. Its soft polyester fill gives it a cuddly shape that sits neatly on a bed or desk, while embroidered details keep the face gentle and simple. The plush measures 9 inches from nose to tail and is suitable for everyday supervised play. Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap, then air dry. A cozy companion for story time, travel, or a shelf full of woodland friends.

title: Folded Paper Miniature Bakery Kit
description: Build a tiny paper bakery, complete with striped awning, display counter, pastry trays, and a hinged front door. The kit contains pre-printed cardstock sheets, peel-and-stick tabs, a scoring tool, and simple illustrated instructions; scissors and glue are optional for extra reinforcement. When assembled, the shop measures about 7 inches wide and works as a display piece or backdrop for small figures. Best suited to crafters ages nine and up, it offers a focused afternoon project with plenty of room to arrange the paper treats.

title: Junior Trail Compass & Map Set
description: Give young explorers a practical starting point for backyard and park navigation. This set pairs a liquid-filled baseplate compass with a laminated, wipe-clean map activity booklet covering map symbols, direction finding, and simple route challenges. The compass has a clear rotating bezel, a lanyard, and a magnifying window for reading printed details. Everything fits into a zippered nylon pouch that measures 6 by 8 inches. Recommended for ages eight and up with adult guidance, it encourages observation and route planning on family walks.

title: Mushroom Village Seek-and-Find Puzzle
description: Piece together a busy woodland village where tiny residents are preparing for a lantern parade. This 300-piece puzzle is printed on sturdy recycled board with a matte finish that helps reduce glare while assembling. The finished image measures 16 by 12 inches and includes a small foldout guide highlighting hidden objects scattered among the mushroom houses, market stalls, and winding paths. Recommended for ages eight and up, it offers a moderate challenge for solo puzzling or a relaxed family table session. Pieces store in a resealable paper bag inside the box.

title: Pocket DJ Beat Pad
description: Make short rhythms and layer simple melodies with this portable electronic beat pad. Sixteen pressure-sensitive buttons trigger drum sounds, tones, and recorded samples, while dedicated controls adjust tempo and switch between four sound banks. A small built-in speaker supports quick play, and a headphone jack lets kids practice quietly. The unit measures 6 inches wide and runs on three AA batteries, not included. Suitable for ages ten and up, it includes a quick-start guide and a short audio cable for connecting to compatible devices.

title: Replacement Spinner and Pawns for Meadow Market
description: Replace a lost or damaged spinner and player pawns from the Meadow Market board game with this small parts pack. The set contains one printed cardboard spinner with its plastic arrow and four wooden pawns in the original player colors. These components are designed for use with Meadow Market and are not a standalone game. Check your game edition before ordering, as the colors and spinner layout may differ from other printings. Parts arrive in a labeled paper envelope for straightforward storage in the game box.

title: Citrus Grove Scratch-Art Bookmark Set
description: Create bright, patterned bookmarks by scratching designs into the black-coated surfaces of this citrus-themed art set. It includes eight sturdy bookmarks, a wooden stylus, cotton tassels, and a small idea sheet with leaf, fruit, and geometric motifs. Each bookmark measures 2 by 6 inches and has a pre-punched hole for its tassel. The technique needs no paint or glue, making it easy to use at a desk or on a rainy afternoon. Recommended for ages six and up with supervision for younger crafters.

title: Pebble Path Wooden Shape Sorter
description: This sturdy shape sorter gives little hands an inviting first go at matching and problem-solving. The compact wooden box has four smooth-edged openings and comes with chunky beechwood shapes in contrasting colors, sized for easy grasping. Lift the sliding lid to retrieve the pieces and start again. A water-based finish keeps the natural grain visible, while rounded corners make the box comfortable to handle during floor play. Measures 6.5 inches across and suits supervised play for toddlers learning to sort, stack, and name shapes.

title: Tidal Turbine Renewable Energy Kit
description: Build a small tabletop turbine and explore how moving water can generate electricity. The kit includes a snap-together turbine housing, plastic blades, a low-voltage generator, connecting wires, and a tiny LED module. Follow the illustrated guide to assemble the unit, then test it under a gentle stream from a faucet or a recirculating basin. A clear cover lets young engineers see the rotor turn as the LED lights. Designed for ages 10 and up; adult help is recommended for setup and water testing.

title: Postcards from the Cat Café
description: In this light strategy game, players run neighboring cat cafés and compete to welcome the most visitors before closing time. Draft menu cards, arrange cozy seating, and match each guest’s preferences to earn points, while a shared event deck brings surprise rushes and changing goals. The box contains a fold-out neighborhood board, 72 cards, wooden cat tokens, visitor markers, and a rulebook. Plays in about 30 minutes with two to four players, making it a friendly pick for family game night or a casual teen meetup.

title: Pip the Pocket-Sized Axolotl Plush
description: Pip is a soft, palm-sized axolotl plush with embroidered gills, a gentle smile, and a plump body that sits neatly on a desk or bedside shelf. Its velvety polyester fabric is paired with recycled polyester filling, and the stitched details avoid hard plastic parts. At 7 inches long, Pip is easy to tuck into a backpack for a day out or keep nearby during reading time. Surface clean with a damp cloth and mild soap; intended as a cuddly companion for ages 3 and up.

title: Pressed Flower Window Suncatcher Kit
description: Create translucent botanical decorations with this beginner-friendly suncatcher set. It includes six clear adhesive panels, dried flower and leaf shapes, colored tissue, hanging cord, and a simple placement guide. Arrange the pieces between the panels, press them together, and hang the finished designs in a bright window to catch the light. Each suncatcher measures about 4 inches across, with enough materials for six projects. Suitable for ages 7 and up; younger crafters can enjoy the activity with help from an adult.

title: Junior Backyard Disc Golf Basket Set
description: Bring a simple disc golf course to the yard or park with a lightweight target and three soft-edged flying discs. The basket frame assembles without tools, with a broad weighted base, fabric catching chains, and a carry bag for storage between games. At 30 inches tall, it offers an approachable target for younger players while remaining easy to move around. Set up short throwing lanes and take turns aiming for the basket. Recommended for ages 6 and up; use in an open area away from windows and traffic.

title: Dinosaur Dig Site 3D Puzzle
description: Piece together a compact prehistoric excavation scene with this layered puzzle that builds into a freestanding display. The 120 sturdy board pieces form a rocky dig site, complete with a small illustrated dinosaur skeleton and numbered field markers. A fold-out base and reference sheet help guide assembly, then support the finished scene on a shelf. The completed model measures approximately 9 by 7 inches. Designed for ages 8 and up, it offers a hands-on puzzle session for dinosaur fans without requiring glue or extra tools.

title: Pocket Weather Radio Explorer
description: This handheld weather explorer introduces young users to radio signals and basic forecast observations. Its compact receiver scans local weather-band broadcasts, while a small LCD displays temperature, humidity, and time from the built-in sensors. The kit includes a detachable antenna, wrist strap, and quick-start booklet with simple listening and observation activities. It runs on two AAA batteries, sold separately, and fits easily into a day bag for trips or backyard weather checks. Intended for ages 10 and up; reception and sensor readings vary with location and conditions.

title: Little Baker's Felt Sandwich Set
description: Invite toddlers into pretend kitchen play with a soft felt sandwich they can assemble again and again. The set includes two bread slices, lettuce, tomato, cheese, and a felt egg, all cut from sturdy wool-blend fabric with stitched edges. Pieces stack easily and are lightweight enough for small hands to carry to a play picnic. The bread measures about 5 inches wide. Made for supervised imaginative play from age 3; store the small toppings out of reach of children under 3.

title: Glowworm Night Hike Lantern Kit
description: Assemble a rechargeable lantern shaped like a friendly glowworm, then learn how a simple circuit powers its soft light. The kit includes a translucent body shell, LED board, switch, USB charging cable, and illustrated assembly instructions. Snap-fit parts keep the build manageable, while a small activity booklet suggests shadow and color experiments for after dark. Once assembled, the lantern stands about 6 inches tall and offers a gentle bedside glow. Recommended for ages 8 and up; an adult should assist with charging and the first build.

title: Backyard Kite & Wind Ribbon Set
description: Take advantage of a breezy afternoon with a compact diamond kite and a handful of colorful wind ribbons. The ripstop nylon kite measures 24 inches across and comes with a fiberglass frame, 50 feet of line, a comfortable winder, and a tail that helps it stay steady in moderate wind. Three ribbon streamers can be tied to the handle or used for simple wind-direction games. Pack everything into the included drawstring pouch. Suitable for ages 6 and up; fly in an open field, away from power lines and storms.

title: Cloud-Climber Wooden Stacking Seesaw
description: A wobbly wooden balancing toy that invites toddlers to stack chunky cloud and raindrop pieces without tipping the little seesaw. The set includes a beechwood base and six painted wooden pieces, each sized for small hands. Smooth edges and water-based colors make it a cheerful choice for supervised play from 18 months. Children can experiment with balance, sort by color, or make up weather stories as they play. Wipe clean with a damp cloth and dry promptly.

title: Build-a-Planetarium Rotating Orrery Kit
description: Assemble a hand-cranked model of the inner solar system and watch the planets travel around the Sun. This 74-piece kit includes laser-cut wooden gears, planet spheres, a sturdy base, paint pots, and illustrated instructions. Young builders learn how gear ratios create different orbital speeds while decorating the finished model to suit their own color scheme. Recommended for ages 10 and up; younger makers may need help with small parts and assembly. No batteries required.

title: Night Market: Lantern Festival Board Game
description: Players race to gather festival treats, deliver glowing lanterns, and complete neighborhood requests before the night market closes. This family strategy game includes a fold-out market board, 96 illustrated cards, wooden lantern tokens, and a cloth drawstring bag. Choose routes carefully: a shortcut may save a turn, but busy stalls can change the plan. Designed for 2–4 players ages 8 and up, with a typical play time of 30–45 minutes. The rules include a cooperative variant.

title: Mallow the Sleepy Cloud Sheep Plush
description: Mallow is a squishy sheep with a cloud-soft fleece coat, embroidered sleepy eyes, and floppy ears made for little hands to hold. The 11-inch plush has a polyester outer shell and filling, with securely stitched details and no hard accessories. It makes a cozy companion for story time, travel, or a bed of stuffed-animal friends. Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap, then air dry. Suitable for ages 3 and up.

title: Pocket Pottery Air-Dry Clay Charm Studio
description: Shape miniature charms, beads, and tiny keepsakes with this compact air-dry clay studio. The kit contains four colors of lightweight clay, a child-safe shaping tool, a texture roller, a hole-making stick, and a booklet with simple project ideas. Finished pieces dry naturally, so there is no oven or kiln needed; add string or paint from home after they harden. Suitable for ages 8 and up. Adult supervision is recommended when using small tools and making hanging holes.

title: Meadow Hopper Adjustable Garden Stilts
description: Give backyard balance practice a playful challenge with these sturdy low-height stilts. Each set includes two molded footholds, adjustable nylon straps, and wide-grip cords that help children steady themselves as they step. The durable plastic platforms sit 4 inches off the ground and support up to 110 pounds. Use on a flat, open surface with an adult nearby, away from stairs, traffic, and hard obstacles. Recommended for ages 6 and up; wipe clean after outdoor adventures.

title: Kelp Forest Hidden-Path Puzzle
description: Explore a lively underwater scene as you piece together sea turtles, tiny fish, and swaying kelp in this 500-piece puzzle. The finished image measures 18 by 24 inches and is printed on thick recycled board with a matte finish to reduce glare. A full-size reference poster is included for helpful hints or display. Pieces come in a reusable paper bag inside a sturdy storage box. Recommended for ages 10 and up, or for younger puzzlers working with an adult.

title: Pocket Pixel Pet: Color-Code Robot Buddy
description: Program a friendly tabletop robot to follow simple paths, blink in patterns, and respond to its included color-code cards. The rechargeable Pixel Pet comes with a USB charging cable, 24 activity cards, and a quick-start guide that introduces sequencing and basic logic without requiring a phone or tablet. Children can create longer routes by combining cards and testing what their robot does next. Recommended for ages 7 and up. Charge with the included cable under adult supervision.

title: Little Harbor Wooden Bath Boat Trio
description: Three smooth wooden boats bring simple pretend play to bath time and water tables. Each boat is made from sealed, sustainably sourced wood and has a different hull shape for little hands to grasp and push through the water. The set includes a sailboat, a tugboat, and a ferry, all sized for toddlers. Rinse with fresh water after use, drain, and leave to dry fully between baths. Designed for supervised play from 18 months; not a teether or flotation device.

title: Color-Shift Slime Chemistry Lab
description: Mix, stretch, and compare three batches of shimmering color-shift slime while exploring polymers and temperature changes. The kit includes premeasured slime ingredients, mixing cups, stir sticks, a thermometer, and a clear experiment guide with cleanup tips. Makers can test how warmth from their hands affects the color and record observations in the included lab notebook. Recommended for ages 8 and up. Adult supervision is advised, and the slime is not edible; wash hands after each experiment.

title: Starlight Window Bead Weaving Kit
description: Weave translucent beads into a starburst sun catcher that catches light in a bedroom or classroom window. The kit includes a reusable plastic weaving frame, 180 acrylic beads in assorted colors, clear cord, a hanging loop, and illustrated step-by-step instructions. The frame keeps the project steady while kids practice patterns and hand-eye coordination, then becomes a small display stand for the finished piece. Recommended for ages 9 and up. Adult help may be useful for tying the final knots.

title: Little Gardener's Wooden Seedling Trowel Set
description: Introduce little hands to garden play with a sturdy wooden trowel, a soft cotton carry pouch, and three chunky wooden plant markers. The smooth beechwood handle is sized for toddlers, while the rounded metal-free blade is designed for scooping potting soil and sand. Markers feature simple engraved pictures of a carrot, sunflower, and pea plant. Use the set for supervised outdoor digging or pretend gardening indoors. Recommended for ages 3 and up; wipe clean after play and store dry.

title: Marble Run: Magnetic Maze Circuit Kit
description: Build a tabletop marble maze and explore gravity, momentum, and simple circuit paths with this 72-piece construction kit. The set includes translucent magnetic track panels, ramps, gates, two steel marbles, and a fold-out challenge booklet with 18 layouts. Clear panels attach to a steel-backed board or refrigerator door, making it easy to test and revise a design. For ages 8 and up, with adult help recommended for younger builders. No batteries or tools are required.

title: Supper Club: A Tabletop Recipe Race
description: Race to assemble a shared menu in this lively strategy game for two to four players. Collect ingredient cards, manage a limited pantry, and complete recipe combinations before the dinner bell rings. The box includes a folding market board, 96 illustrated cards, four wooden chef pawns, recipe tiles, and a quick-start guide. A typical game takes about 25 minutes, making it a good fit for family game night or a teen get-together. Recommended for ages 8 and up.

title: Pesto the Pocket-Sized Frog Plush
description: Meet Pesto, a soft little frog with velvety green fabric, embroidered eyes, and a weighted base that helps him sit on a shelf or desk. At 7 inches tall, he fits easily into a backpack for car rides and sleepovers. The plush is made from polyester fabric with recycled polyester filling, and all facial details are stitched rather than plastic. Spot clean with a damp cloth and air dry. Suitable for ages 3 and up.

title: Color Wheel Window Mosaic Sticker Studio
description: Create bright window mosaics without glue, scissors, or loose glass with this reusable sticker studio. Inside are 240 translucent vinyl shapes in jewel tones, a 10-by-12-inch clear design sheet, and four illustrated pattern guides. Layer the shapes to make flowers, geometric patterns, or an original sun-catcher, then press the finished design onto a clean window. The stickers peel away and can be rearranged for another project. Recommended for ages 6 and up; adult supervision is suggested during application.

title: Mini Meadow Archery Set with Suction-Cup Arrows
description: Practice aiming and coordination with a child-sized bow set designed for backyard targets. The kit includes a lightweight fiberglass bow, three foam-tipped suction-cup arrows, a removable target face, and a drawstring storage bag. The target can hang from a fence or stand against a flat surface, and the arrows release with a comfortable pull for younger players. Use only with adult supervision in an open area, and never aim toward people or animals. Recommended for ages 8 and up.

title: Night Garden: 500-Piece Glow-Detail Puzzle
description: Piece together a moonlit botanical scene filled with moths, seed pods, and night-blooming flowers. This 500-piece puzzle uses matte-finish recycled board and includes subtle glow-in-the-dark accents that reveal extra details after exposure to light. The completed image measures 18 by 24 inches, with a full-color reference poster tucked inside the box. Pieces are cut to varied shapes for a satisfying build suited to older kids, teens, and adults. Recommended for ages 10 and up.

title: Pocket Rover: Bluetooth-Controlled Drawing Bot
description: Program a tiny rover to trace paths, draw shapes, and follow simple commands from a tablet or phone. The kit includes a compact two-wheel robot, washable marker holder, three markers, USB charging cable, and a set of printable coding challenges. A free companion app uses block-based instructions to introduce sequencing and loops, with manual controls for open-ended play. The rover is approximately 4 inches long and recharges in about 90 minutes. Designed for ages 8 and up; device not included.

title: Soft Start Tummy-Time Water Play Mat
description: Give babies a colorful surface to explore during supervised tummy time. This 20-inch square mat has a soft fabric border, a sealed water-filled center, and floating shapes that drift when the mat is gently pressed. The outer surface is made from wipe-clean polyester, and the filling is sealed inside a durable PVC chamber. Lay the mat flat on the floor and check it for leaks before each use. Intended for babies from 3 months; never leave an infant unattended.

title: Build a Backyard Sundial and Shadow Tracker
description: Turn a sunny afternoon into a hands-on lesson about shadows and the Earth's rotation. This kit includes a 9-inch wooden sundial base, adjustable gnomon, reusable shadow-tracking chart, pencil, and illustrated experiment booklet. Builders assemble the pieces with a simple press-fit design, then record how the shadow shifts throughout the day. The activity also includes ideas for comparing observations across seasons. Recommended for ages 7 and up; adult help may be useful during assembly. No batteries are needed.

title: The Great Blanket Fort Challenge Deck
description: Draw a challenge card, gather household supplies, and invent a fort that meets the brief. This screen-free activity set contains 60 prompt cards, a 12-minute sand timer, a reusable score pad, and a small fabric flag to mark the finished fort. Prompts range from building a reading nook with two chairs to designing a tunnel entrance, with cooperative and competitive play options. Best for two to six players and easy to adapt for different ages. Recommended for ages 6 and up.

title: Little Lighthouse Wooden Shape-and-Stack Boat
description: This chunky wooden boat invites toddlers to sort, stack, and make up stories about a trip along the shore. Four removable pieces—a lighthouse, sail, gull, and buoy—fit into shaped spaces on the deck and can be lifted out for open-ended play. Made from smooth, FSC-certified beechwood with water-based paint, it measures 9 inches long and includes a cotton storage pouch. Use it for supervised sorting practice or imaginative play; the pieces are sized for little hands, not for children under 18 months.

title: Mini Tidal Pool Water Testing Kit
description: Turn a shoreline walk into a simple investigation with this beginner water-testing kit. It includes a pocket pH meter, three reusable sample vials, a small magnifier, a waterproof observation card, and a guide to recording temperature and visible features. The meter runs on two AAA batteries, sold separately. Designed for ages 8 and up, the kit works with collected water samples from ponds or tide pools; it is for observation only, and samples should never be tasted. Everything packs into a zippered 8-by-6-inch case.

title: Lantern Lane: A Cooperative Night Market Game
description: Players work together to help neighborhood stalls prepare for a lively evening market before the lanterns go out. Each round, choose ingredient and decoration cards, then coordinate moves to complete customer orders without crowding the narrow streets. The game includes a folding board, 72 cards, wooden stall markers, a sand timer, and a quick-start sheet. It takes about 25 minutes for two to four players ages 8 and up, with adjustable goals for a shorter first game. The illustrated box stores all components in a fitted tray.

title: Clover the Pocket-Sized Raincloud Plush
description: Clover is a palm-sized raincloud companion with a soft gray velour body, embroidered sleepy eyes, and three dangling raindrop ribbons in muted blue cotton. The plush measures 7 inches from cloud top to ribbon ends and is filled with recycled polyester fiber. A small fabric loop makes it easy to attach to a backpack or display on a bedroom hook. Surface clean with a damp cloth and air dry. Suitable for ages 3 and up; the attached ribbons are decorative, so this toy is not intended for crib use.

title: Big-Color Window Chalk Set
description: Make temporary pictures on glass with six chunky, water-soluble chalk markers in bright, easy-to-see colors. The broad tips suit lettering and filled-in shapes, while the included 12-page idea booklet offers prompts for weather scenes, birthday messages, and seasonal window art. Each marker has a 5 mm tip and a ventilated cap; wipe drawings away with a damp cloth when finished. The set is designed for ages 6 and up and works best on smooth, nonporous surfaces. Test a small area first and store markers capped horizontally.

title: Junior Backyard Paddle Ball Rally Set
description: Bring a simple rally game to the yard, beach, or park with two lightweight paddles and a soft foam ball. The paddles have rounded edges, textured grips, and adjustable wrist loops to help keep them in hand during play. Each measures 15 inches long; the ball is 2.5 inches across and designed for gentle, close-range hits. A mesh carry sack holds the set between outings. Recommended for ages 6 and up, this is an outdoor activity toy rather than a competitive regulation set. Play in an open area away from windows and faces.

title: The Clockwork Garden 350-Piece Puzzle
description: Piece together a whimsical greenhouse where tiny brass gadgets help vines curl around pots, watering cans, and glass panes. The 350-piece puzzle uses sturdy recycled board with a matte finish to reduce glare and includes a full-color reference sheet. When complete, the image measures 18 by 24 inches, a comfortable size for a dining table or puzzle mat. Recommended for ages 10 and up, it offers a moderate challenge for solo puzzling or a relaxed family session. Pieces arrive in a resealable paper bag inside a compact box.

title: Pocket Pixel Pet: Replacement USB-C Charging Cable
description: Keep compatible Pocket Pixel Pet companions ready for play with this spare 3-foot USB-C charging cable. One end connects to the toy’s charging port and the other plugs into a standard USB power source; an adapter is not included. The cable has a flexible braided jacket and reinforced connectors for everyday use in a backpack or playroom drawer. Check your device’s port before ordering, as this accessory is not a universal charger for all electronic toys. It contains one cable only and does not include a pet, battery, or charging block.

title: Fold-and-Fly Paper Glider Workshop
description: Build, decorate, and test a fleet of paper gliders with this hands-on activity set. It includes 30 patterned sheets, 10 sturdy cardstock nose weights, reusable sticker eyes, and a 16-page folding guide with three designs ranging from easy to more advanced. Children can adjust folds and launch angles to compare how each glider travels. The kit is suited to ages 7 and up and works best in a clear indoor hallway or an open outdoor space. No scissors or glue are required, and finished gliders fold flat for storage.

title: Glow Pebble Constellation Projector
description: Project a gentle star pattern onto a bedroom wall or ceiling with this compact, kid-friendly constellation lamp. A rotating perforated dome creates moving points of light, while three interchangeable discs show a star field, moon phases, and simple constellation outlines. The 5-inch projector is made from ABS plastic and includes a USB-A power cable; a wall adapter is not included. Use the focus ring to sharpen patterns at different distances and switch between steady and slow-rotation modes. Recommended for ages 6 and up, it is intended as a playroom light, not a precision astronomy tool.

title: Spare Felt Food Set for Little Market Kitchen
description: This replacement bundle adds a few extra pretend ingredients to a play kitchen or market stall: one felt pear, one carrot, and a small loaf of bread. Each piece is hand-sewn from layered wool-blend felt with embroidered details and soft polyester filling, measuring about 3 to 5 inches long. The set is sold as three food pieces only; no basket, play kitchen, or other accessories are included. Intended for supervised pretend play with children ages 3 and up, it is a practical restock for well-loved play sets rather than a complete gift bundle.

title: Little Orchard Wooden Lacing Shapes
description: Bring hands-on play to quiet afternoons with a set of chunky wooden shapes inspired by a little orchard. The eight pieces include an apple, pear, leaf, and more, each with a smooth, water-based finish and a large threading hole. A cotton lace with a rounded wooden tip is sized for small hands to guide through the shapes. Designed for supervised play, this simple activity encourages early hand-eye coordination and can be packed into the included drawstring cotton bag.

title: Pocket Fossil Imprint Discovery Kit
description: Make and examine fossil-style impressions with this beginner geology kit. It includes two reusable silicone imprint molds, air-dry modeling compound, a wooden pressing tool, a magnifier, and illustrated activity cards featuring shells, fern fronds, and trilobite shapes. Children can press a mold into the compound, let the impression dry, then inspect its details up close. The activity cards introduce basic ideas about patterns and preservation. Adult supervision is recommended during setup; allow the finished impressions to dry overnight before handling.

title: Moonlit Mail: A Cooperative Delivery Game
description: Players work together to deliver invitations across a moonlit town before the festival bell rings. This cooperative game includes a foldout neighborhood board, 60 illustrated destination cards, wooden parcel tokens, and a sand timer. On each turn, players plan a route, share clues, and decide which packages to carry through changing street conditions. The rules are designed for two to four players, with a typical game taking about 25 minutes. Recommended for ages eight and up; no app or batteries are needed.

title: Nori the Little Raincoat Seal Plush
description: Nori is a soft seal plush dressed for a pretend rainy-day adventure, with a removable-look yellow raincoat sewn securely in place. The seal is made from short-pile polyester plush with embroidered eyes and a lightly weighted lower body for sitting on a shelf or bedside table. It measures 10 inches from nose to tail, making it easy to carry along on trips. Surface clean with a damp cloth and mild soap, then air dry.
