Suitable as a cuddly companion for older children; not intended for infants under three.

title: Color-Block Fabric Banner Sewing Set
description: Create a small hanging banner with pre-cut cotton fabric pieces in a cheerful geometric palette. The kit contains six fabric shapes, a felt backing, blunt plastic needle, embroidery floss, wooden dowel, and a simple illustrated guide. Children can stitch or lace the pieces onto the backing, then tie on the cord for display. The finished banner measures approximately 8 by 11 inches, depending on placement. This beginner-friendly project is best for ages seven and up, with an adult nearby to help thread the needle and finish knots.

title: Creekside Scout Balance Trail Set
description: Set up a low-to-the-ground balance course in the yard or at a park with six flexible stepping pads and two textured balance beams. The pads are made from weather-resistant molded plastic with grippy tops, while the beams have rounded edges for easy carrying. Arrange the pieces in a straight path or create a winding route, then adjust the spacing as confidence grows. The set supports active, imaginative play for children ages four and up. Includes a mesh storage bag; use on a level surface with adult supervision.

title: Tiny Tides: 120-Piece Coastal Floor Puzzle
description: Explore a lively shoreline scene featuring tide pools, seabirds, seaweed, and tiny details tucked among the rocks. This 120-piece puzzle uses sturdy recycled board with a matte finish that helps reduce glare while assembling. The completed image measures 18 by 12 inches, a comfortable size for a table or floor. A full-color reference sheet is included in the box. Designed for puzzlers ages six and up, it offers a manageable challenge for solo play or a relaxed family activity on a rainy afternoon.

title: Pocket Code Critter: Programmable Rover
description: Program a small wheeled rover to follow a route, avoid obstacles, or make a series of turns using the included button controls. The kit includes the rover, two foam obstacle pieces, a washable route mat, and a USB-C charging cable. Its simple onboard controls introduce sequencing without requiring a phone or account. The rover measures about 5 inches long and has a rechargeable battery for indoor play on smooth floors. Recommended for ages eight and up; charge and operate under adult supervision, and keep away from water.

title: Little Baker's Wooden Rolling Pin & Dough Set
description: Give pretend bakery play a tactile start with a child-sized wooden rolling pin and three brightly colored modeling dough tubs. The rolling pin is turned from smooth beechwood with rounded handles, and the dough comes in resealable containers to help keep it fresh between play sessions. Children can roll, flatten, and shape the dough on a clean table or play mat. The pin measures 7 inches long; each tub holds 3 ounces. For ages three and up. Dough is for play only and should not be eaten.

title: Star Chart Scratch-Off Planetarium Cards
description: Turn constellation practice into a hands-on activity with a set of scratch-off night-sky cards. Each of 12 sturdy cards has a dark coated surface and a printed star map beneath; use the included wooden stylus to reveal selected lines and labels. The set also includes a small guide with seasonal viewing prompts and blank cards for drawing original patterns. Cards measure 4 by 6 inches and fit easily in a backpack. Made for ages eight and up, this screen-free craft combines careful scratching with introductory sky watching.

title: Build-and-Launch Water Rocket Workshop
description: Assemble a reusable foam-tipped rocket and explore how launch angle and water volume affect its flight. The kit includes a plastic launch base, hand pump, bottle connector, rocket fins, nose cone, and a measuring cup for adding water to a standard bottle. Illustrated experiment sheets provide space to record each test and compare results. Use outdoors on an open lawn with adult supervision; the launch base requires a compatible empty plastic bottle, which is not included. Recommended for ages ten and up. Never aim the rocket toward people or animals.

title: First Orchard Wooden Pull-Up Walker
description: Made for new walkers, this sturdy push toy pairs a smooth beechwood frame with four quiet rubber-trimmed wheels. A low front handle is easy for small hands to grip, while a removable cotton basket carries favorite board books or soft toys. The walker measures 13 inches long and includes a simple wheel-speed adjustment for different floors. Use it on a clear, level surface with an adult nearby; the basket can be removed for a lighter first push.

title: Pocket Circuit: Light-Up Logic Lab
description: Explore switches, circuits, and simple problem-solving with a compact electronics kit designed for curious builders. The set includes a snap-together board, insulated connector wires, LEDs, a buzzer, and a 32-page illustrated activity booklet with 20 experiments. No soldering is required, and parts store in the included lidded tray. Children can build a touch-sensitive light, test series and parallel circuits, then invent a signal of their own. Recommended for ages 8 and up; adult help is useful for younger experimenters.

title: Foxglove Ferry: A Woodland Trading Game
description: Players take on the roles of woodland couriers, collecting parcels and ferrying them across a changing stream before dusk. This family strategy game includes a double-sided board, 60 parcel cards, 24 wooden cargo tokens, four ferry pawns, and a six-sided die. Turns are quick: choose a route, trade a parcel, or shift a stepping stone to open a new crossing. Designed for two to four players, it takes about 30 minutes and is suitable for ages 7 and up.

title: Bramble the Blueberry Hedgehog Plush
description: A soft companion for story time, car rides, and quiet corners, Bramble has a rounded blueberry-blue body, embroidered sleepy eyes, and a plush-textured back that suggests tiny hedgehog spines without any scratchy pieces. The 10-inch plush is sewn from polyester velboa with recycled polyester filling and has securely stitched details. Spot-clean with a damp cloth and mild soap, then air-dry. Suitable for ages 3 and up; this cuddly forest friend makes an easy addition to a small gift basket.

title: Color Garden Watercolor Postcard Set
description: Paint, personalize, and send a miniature garden scene with this beginner-friendly watercolor set. It contains 24 heavyweight postcards, six watercolor pans, a round brush, and a printed mixing guide with ideas for leaves, seed pods, and garden birds. Each card measures 4 by 6 inches and has a blank message area on the reverse. The paper is sturdy enough for small washes and layered color. Made for ages 6 and up; let finished paintings dry flat before writing or mailing.

title: Creek Hopper Folding Balance Bike
description: This lightweight balance bike helps young riders practice steering and coordination on paved paths and smooth playground surfaces. It features a powder-coated steel frame, puncture-resistant 12-inch tires, an adjustable padded seat, and soft-grip handlebars. The quick-folding frame tucks into a car trunk or closet between outings, and a small rear carry handle makes it easier for adults to lift. Fits most riders with an inseam of 14 to 18 inches. A properly fitted helmet and close adult supervision are recommended.

title: Cloudberry Bakery: 100-Piece Giant Floor Puzzle
description: Build a busy little bakery scene in oversized pieces made for floor play. The 100-piece puzzle shows bakers, berry tarts, bread baskets, and a shop cat among warm pink and cream details. Finished size is 24 by 18 inches, with thick, matte-finished cardboard pieces that are easy for smaller hands to pick up. A full-color reference poster is included in the sturdy storage box. Recommended for ages 5 and up; piece shapes vary to make sorting part of the fun.

title: Pocket Star Engineer: Robotic Arm Builder
description: Build a small motorized arm that grips, lifts, and moves lightweight objects with this hands-on robotics kit. The set includes pre-cut plastic frame pieces, a low-voltage motor, battery holder, control switches, and illustrated assembly instructions. Once assembled, the four-button wired controller lets builders practice precise movements and experiment with the arm's reach. It measures about 9 inches tall when complete and requires two AA batteries, not included. Recommended for ages 10 and up; assembly takes roughly two to three hours.

title: Little Rainmaker Wooden Rolling Drum
description: A gentle first instrument, this wooden rolling drum makes a soft rain-like sound as it turns across the floor. The sealed birchwood cylinder contains colorful wooden beads visible through clear acrylic end panels, with smooth edges and a water-based finish. At 6 inches long, it is easy for babies to reach, grasp, and roll during supervised play. Wipe clean with a damp cloth and dry promptly; do not submerge. Designed for ages 12 months and up, with no detachable parts.

title: Moon Garden Glow-In-The-Dark Paint Studio
description: Create a night-sky garden on canvas with this paint studio for older kids and teens. The kit includes three 8-by-10-inch canvases, six washable acrylic paint pots, two glow-in-the-dark paints, a detail brush, a flat brush, and a reusable stencil sheet of moons, moths, and leaves. A step-by-step guide covers layering, blending, and charging glow paint under a lamp. Protect work surfaces and wash brushes soon after use. Recommended for ages 9 and up; adult supervision is advised when handling paint.

title: First Steps Wooden Rainbow Arch Stacker
description: This chunky wooden arch stacker invites little hands to build bridges, tunnels, and wobbly towers. It includes six smooth, graduated beechwood arches finished with water-based, child-safe colors. Each piece is sized for easy gripping and nests together for tidy storage on a nursery shelf. Offer the arches for open-ended play, color matching, or simple sorting as toddlers grow. Suitable for ages 18 months and up; adult supervision is recommended during play.

title: Magnetic Moon Base Engineering Kit
description: Build a modular lunar outpost and explore how magnets, balance, and simple circuits work together. The kit includes magnetic construction panels, connectors, a battery-powered LED module, astronaut figures, and a 24-page illustrated activity guide. Kids can assemble a rover garage, antenna tower, or custom habitat, then test which structures stay stable on a tilted surface. Designed for ages 8 and up. Requires two AAA batteries, not included.

title: Mosswood Mapmakers
description: In this family strategy game, players chart woodland paths, gather supplies, and connect hidden landmarks before the season changes. The box includes a double-sided game board, 96 trail tiles, 60 resource tokens, four wooden traveler pieces, and illustrated cards. Turns are quick to learn, with route choices that reward planning and a shared map that changes as everyone plays. For 2–4 players ages 8 and up; a typical game takes about 35 minutes.

title: Tansy the Pocket Garden Snail Plush
description: Tansy is a soft, squishable garden snail with a velvety sage-green body and a spiral shell made from textured corduroy. Measuring 8 inches from feelers to tail, this compact plush fits easily in a backpack or reading nook. Embroidered eyes and securely stitched details make it a cozy companion for story time and imaginative play. The outer fabric is polyester with recycled fiber fill. Surface wash gently and air dry; recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Printmaking Patterns: Foam Stamp Studio
description: Make repeating prints, greeting cards, and wrapping paper with this beginner-friendly foam stamp set. It contains 12 reusable geometric and nature-inspired stamps, three washable ink pads, a small brayer, and 20 sheets of heavyweight paper. The easy-grip stamp handles are designed for children, while the pattern guide offers simple ideas for layering colors and building borders. Suitable for ages 6 and up. Protect work surfaces and wash stamps with soap and water after use.

title: Junior Creekside Climbing Cargo Net
description: Turn a sturdy backyard play structure into a climbing challenge with this weather-resistant cargo net. Woven polyester rope forms a 6-by-4-foot grid with reinforced perimeter edges and attachment loops at each corner. The net encourages coordination and active outdoor play for children ages 5 and up. Mount it only to a secure structure rated for climbing, and check all connections before each use. Hardware is not included, since suitable fasteners depend on the installation surface.

title: Under the Ice: Arctic Research Puzzle
description: Piece together an illustrated research station, snowy coastline, and curious arctic animals in this 500-piece puzzle. The finished image measures 18 by 24 inches and is printed on thick recycled board with a matte finish to reduce glare. A full-color reference poster is included for puzzlers who want a little guidance. Designed for ages 10 and up, it suits solo afternoons or a shared table project. Store the pieces in the included paper pouch between sessions.

title: Pocket Synth Garden: Modular Music Lab
description: Explore electronic sound by connecting snap-together modules to create a pocket-sized synthesizer. The set includes a speaker, touch-sensitive keys, three sound-shaping modules, a battery pack, and illustrated build cards with experiments for pitch and rhythm. No soldering is required, and the connections can be rearranged for new sounds. The finished instrument measures about 6 inches across and runs on three AAA batteries, not included. Recommended for ages 9 and up.

title: Little Baker's Wooden Market Crate Set
description: Bring pretend market play to the playroom with a set of three wooden crates sized for small hands. The set includes a bread crate, a produce crate, and a shallow sorting tray, all made from smooth, unfinished pine with rounded corners. Children can carry, stack, and fill the pieces with play food or blocks, then use them to organize a pretend shop. Each crate is approximately 7 inches wide. Recommended for ages 3 and up; play food is sold separately.

title: Doodle Deck: Storytelling Card Game
description: Turn quick sketches into silly shared stories with a card game made for creative groups. The deck includes 90 prompt cards, 30 twist cards, a six-sided wooden die, and a small sketch pad. Players draw a prompt, doodle an idea, then use each other's drawings to improvise a short tale. There is no single winner, so the rules work well for mixed ages and casual game nights. For 3–8 players ages 7 and up; pencils are not included.

title: Glow Trail Rechargeable Bug Viewer
description: Take a closer look at backyard discoveries with this handheld illuminated bug viewer. Its clear observation chamber has a magnifying lens, air vents, and a soft green LED ring that makes details easier to see at dusk. The viewer includes a removable carry handle, a measuring grid on the base, and a USB-C rechargeable battery. Children can observe insects briefly before returning them to their habitat. Measures 7 inches tall and is recommended for ages 6 and up.

title: Little Tidepool Wooden Bath Pourers
description: Make bath time a gentle pouring-and-splashing game with this set of three chunky wooden sea-creature cups. Each piece is made from sealed, water-resistant beechwood and has a different opening for exploring how water flows. The cups measure about 3 inches tall and are sized for small hands to grasp and stack. Rinse with fresh water after play and let them dry thoroughly between baths. Designed for supervised play; not intended as a teether.

title: Snap-Together Solar Bug Rover Kit
description: Build a small crawling rover powered by a compact solar panel, then test how its movement changes in bright sun and shade. The kit includes a motor, wheels, chassis pieces, panel, and illustrated assembly guide; no soldering is required. Finished rover measures about 6 inches long. Young builders can investigate energy transfer and simple circuits while adjusting the leg mechanism for different surfaces. Best suited to ages 8 and up, with an adult nearby for the small components.

title: Lanternfish Lagoon: Family Bluffing Game
description: In this quick family game, players guide schools of lanternfish through a shifting reef while trying to predict which routes other players will choose. The set includes a fold-out board, 60 fish tokens, route cards, and a cloth drawstring bag. Rounds take about 25 minutes and support two to five players. Simple turns make it easy to teach, while secret choices add a little friendly bluffing. Recommended for ages 8 and up; store the small tokens in the included bag.

title: Puddle the Rain Boots Duck Plush
description: Puddle is a soft, palm-sized duck plush wearing stitched yellow rain boots and a blue fabric scarf. Its body is made from velvety polyester fabric with embroidered eyes and recycled polyester fill, so there are no hard plastic details. At 8 inches tall, it fits easily into a backpack for car rides or quiet-time play. Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap, then air dry. Suitable for ages 3 and up.

title: Mini Loom Friendship Bracelet Studio
description: This compact bracelet-making set gives young crafters an easy way to practice colorful weaving. Inside are a reusable plastic mini loom, blunt-ended yarn needle, 12 skeins of cotton embroidery thread, and a printed pattern booklet with six designs. The loom measures 5 inches across and fits on a desk or lap tray. Finished bracelets can be tied on or given to friends. Recommended for ages 8 and up; adult help may be useful when threading the first project.

title: Comet Tail Foam Disc Set
description: Turn a park visit into an easy throwing game with two lightweight foam discs and four bright ribbon tails. The soft discs are made from flexible EVA foam, measure 9 inches across, and are simple for children to grip and retrieve. Add or remove the clip-on tails to change the flight feel, then make up target games or practice gentle throws in an open area. Includes a mesh storage bag. Intended for outdoor use with space around players.

title: Rainforest Canopy Layer Puzzle
description: Explore the layers of a tropical rainforest with this 300-piece puzzle, illustrated with toucans, tree frogs, orchids, and winding vines. The finished image measures 18 by 24 inches and includes a full-color reference sheet. Pieces are made from sturdy recycled board with a matte finish to reduce glare during longer sessions. The varied shapes offer a satisfying challenge for older children and families. Recommended for ages 9 and up; store pieces in the resealable paper bag between sessions.

title: Pocket Marble Run Refill Pack
description: Keep a marble run in working order with this practical refill pack of 24 glass marbles in assorted opaque colors. Each marble is approximately 16 millimeters wide and packed in a small cardboard tube with a screw-top lid. The set is intended as replacement or extra play pieces for compatible marble-run toys, not as a standalone game. Small parts can pose a choking hazard, so keep them away from children under 3 and supervise play. A useful spare to keep in the craft drawer.

title: Pocket Telescope Moon Tracker
description: A beginner-friendly handheld telescope for observing the Moon, distant rooftops, and other easy-to-find sights. The 30 mm objective lens and 12x magnification provide a clear starting view, while the adjustable focus wheel helps young observers sharpen the image. The kit includes a tabletop tripod, soft carry pouch, and a fold-out lunar observation chart. Telescope body measures about 10 inches long. Recommended for ages 8 and up; use with adult guidance and never point toward the Sun.

title: Cedar Creek Wooden Critter Bowling
description: Set up a pint-sized bowling lane indoors or on a smooth patio with six painted wooden woodland pins and a matching ball. The pins feature simple fox, bear, owl, and rabbit faces, finished with water-based paint on sustainably sourced wood. Each pin stands about 5 inches tall, making them easy for young players to arrange and knock down. A cotton drawstring bag keeps the pieces together after play. Recommended for ages 3 and up; use on a level surface.

title: Little Acorn Wooden Shape-Sorting Barn
description: This sturdy wooden barn gives little hands a satisfying first sorting challenge. Four chunky farm-animal shapes fit through matching openings, while a hinged roof makes it easy to retrieve them and start again. Made from smooth, FSC-certified beech wood with water-based, child-safe finishes, the barn measures 7.5 inches wide and is sized for toddlers to grasp. Use it for color and shape play, animal-name practice, or simple turn-taking. Adult supervision is recommended, especially for children under three.

title: Pocket Planetarium: Build a Spinning Solar System
description: Build a hand-cranked solar system model and watch the planets travel around a printed sun. The kit includes pre-cut cardboard orbit arms, a wooden base, planet spheres, paint pots, a brush, fasteners, and an illustrated assembly guide. Once assembled, the model measures about 12 inches tall and turns without batteries. It’s a hands-on introduction to orbital motion, planet order, and careful construction for ages eight and up. Allow about two hours for assembly and decorating; an adult can help with the small connectors.

title: Maple Street Mystery: The Case of the Missing Pie
description: A neighborhood pie has vanished, and every player has a clue to follow in this light deduction game for two to five players. Move between illustrated street locations, trade information, and compare suspect cards before making your final guess. The box includes a fold-out board, 60 clue and character cards, five wooden pawns, a notepad, and a quick-start guide. A round takes about 25 minutes, making it a good fit for family game night. Recommended for ages eight and up.

title: Miso the Sleepy Red Panda Plush
description: Miso is a floppy red panda plush made for cuddling, quiet-time stories, and tagging along on trips. Its rust-colored body has a cream face, embroidered features, and a striped tail with soft, low-pile fabric that’s easy to hug. Miso measures 11 inches from nose to tail and is lightly filled with recycled polyester. Surface wash with a damp cloth and mild soap, then air-dry. This plush is intended for children ages three and up and is not designed as a crib toy.

title: Pressed Leaf Printmaking Starter Studio
description: Turn collected leaves into bold, repeatable prints with this beginner-friendly printmaking set. Inside are six washable ink pads, a soft brayer, a reusable printing plate, a sketch booklet, and 12 sheets of heavyweight paper. Children can arrange leaves, trace their outlines, or layer simple shapes to make cards and wall art. The tools pack into a lidded storage tray, and the water-based inks clean up with soap and water. Designed for ages seven and up; adult help is useful when setting up the plate.

title: Creekside Explorer Bug-Safe Observation Dome
description: Give backyard discoveries a closer look with this clear observation dome, designed for brief, gentle viewing before insects are released. The ventilated lid has a magnifying window, a sliding access door, and a built-in measuring grid. It includes a soft-bristle brush, a small leaf-shaped scoop, and a field card for recording what you find. The dome is 8 inches across and made from durable, lightweight plastic. Intended for supervised outdoor exploration; keep live animals out of direct sun and return them to their habitat promptly.

title: Alpine Cabin 300-Piece Jigsaw Puzzle
description: Piece together a mountain cabin tucked among snowy pines beneath a clear winter sky. This 300-piece puzzle uses sturdy recycled board with a matte finish to reduce glare and includes a full-color reference poster. Finished size is 18 by 12 inches, a comfortable scale for a kitchen table or shared family workspace. Pieces have varied shapes for an engaging build without an overwhelming piece count. Recommended for ages eight and up; store the puzzle in its sturdy box between sessions.

title: Pocket Beat Lab: Tap-and-Loop Music Pad
description: Make short rhythms and layer them into a song with this compact, battery-powered music pad. Eight pressure-sensitive pads trigger drum and synth sounds, while simple record and playback buttons let players build loops without a phone or computer. The unit includes a built-in speaker, headphone jack, adjustable volume, and a printed starter rhythm guide. It measures 6 inches across and runs on three AAA batteries (not included). Designed for ages eight and up, it’s a playful introduction to beat-making and musical timing.

title: First Kitchen Wooden Pour-and-Serve Tea Set
description: Set up a pretend tea party with this compact wooden serving set made for preschool hands. It includes a lidded teapot, two cups, two saucers, a small tray, and four wooden tea-bag tokens. Pieces are crafted from responsibly sourced rubberwood and finished with smooth, water-based colors. The tray measures 9 inches long and keeps everything together for easy storage. Use it for imaginative play, sharing practice, and simple conversations about hosting. Recommended for ages three and up; decorative pieces are not intended for real food or drink.

title: Wind-Powered Pinwheel Racer Workshop
description: Build a small racer that moves using a pinwheel and the power of a breeze. The kit includes a snap-together chassis, lightweight wheels, a paper pinwheel template, a reusable straw launcher, and materials for testing different sail shapes. Young makers can adjust axle placement and compare how the car travels indoors with a fan or outside in gentle wind. The finished vehicle is about 7 inches long. Recommended for ages seven and up; scissors for the paper template and adult help may be needed.

title: Rainbow Ribbon Dance Wand Pair
description: Encourage movement and imaginative play with two lightweight ribbon wands in bright, easy-to-spot colors. Each 14-inch wand has a smooth wooden handle and a flowing, 6-foot satin ribbon that trails through spins, skips, and simple dance patterns. The set includes a small drawstring pouch for carrying to the park or storing at home. Suitable for outdoor play, movement breaks, and beginner choreography. Recommended for ages five and up; ribbons should be used with supervision and kept away from the face and neck.

title: First Forest Wooden Knob Puzzle
description: Introduce little hands to matching and problem-solving with this sturdy wooden knob puzzle, featuring a fox, mushroom, fern, and bird. Each chunky piece has a smooth, easy-grip wooden peg sized for small fingers. The 9 × 9-inch board is made from responsibly sourced beechwood and finished with child-safe, water-based colors. Use it for quiet floor play, early shape recognition, or a simple parent-and-child naming game. Four pieces keep the activity approachable for toddlers while encouraging careful placement and coordination.

title: Crystal Cave Geode Growing Lab
description: Grow colorful crystal formations at home with a hands-on geology kit designed for curious junior scientists. The set includes two crystal-growing compounds, a mixing cup, wooden stir stick, display bases, safety goggles, and an illustrated experiment guide. Children measure warm water, mix the solution with adult supervision, and watch crystals develop over several days. Finished specimens can be displayed on the included bases. Suitable for ages 8 and up; the kit makes two small formations and includes clear cleanup and safety instructions.

title: Railway Riddle: The Midnight Express
description: Work together to solve a train-station mystery before the midnight express departs. Players collect clue cards, compare passenger alibis, and use a shared route board to piece together where a missing parcel was last seen. The game includes a fold-out board, 72 cards, six wooden train tokens, and a simple case-file booklet. Designed for two to five players ages 9 and up, a typical session takes about 30 minutes. Multiple mystery setups keep repeat plays fresh without relying on a game master.

title: Marmalade the Moonlit Moth Plush
description: Marmalade is a cuddly moth companion with velvety charcoal wings, embroidered golden spots, and soft cream-colored antennae. The 11-inch plush is filled with resilient recycled polyester fiber and has securely stitched facial details rather than plastic eyes. Its gently weighted lower body helps it sit upright on a bedside shelf or reading nook. Designed for hugs, imaginative play, and comforting company on trips, Marmalade is surface-washable with a damp cloth. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Print-a-Planet Reusable Stencil Art Set
description: Make a series of colorful space scenes with reusable planet, rocket, and star stencils. This compact art set includes 12 flexible plastic stencils, 24 sheets of heavyweight drawing paper, six washable markers, and a zippered storage pouch. Children can layer shapes to design their own solar systems, create comic panels, or decorate handmade cards. The stencils rinse clean after use and are sized for small hands to hold steady. A practical rainy-day activity for ages 5 and up.

title: Backyard Breeze Kite-Flying Kit
description: Take to an open field with a beginner-friendly diamond kite made from ripstop polyester and a flexible fiberglass frame. The 24-inch kite comes with a 100-foot flying line, easy-grip winder, tail ribbons, and a illustrated guide to basic launch and wind safety. Its bright striped design is easy to spot against the sky, while the lightweight frame packs into the included carry sleeve. Best for moderate breezes and open spaces away from trees and power lines. Recommended for ages 6 and up.

title: Deep Sea Diner 300-Piece Puzzle
description: Piece together a bustling underwater café where seahorses serve kelp noodles and little crabs pick the day's dessert. This 300-piece jigsaw is printed with crisp, low-glare colors on sturdy recycled board, with a finished size of 18 × 12 inches. The varied shapes offer an engaging challenge for older children and families without being overwhelming. A full-color reference poster is included, along with a reusable paper storage bag for keeping pieces together between sessions. Recommended for ages 8 and up.

title: Pocket Beatbox Voice Changer
description: Turn everyday sounds into silly loops with this handheld voice-changer and beat-making toy. The palm-sized unit records short clips, adds selectable pitch effects, and lets kids trigger simple percussion sounds with four large buttons. A built-in speaker and adjustable volume make it ready to use straight from the box; a standard headphone jack supports quieter listening. It runs on three AAA batteries (not included) and includes a quick-start card with playful sound prompts. Recommended for ages 8 and up.

title: Little Workshop Wooden Screw-and-Build Bench
description: Give preschool builders a satisfying first tool set with a compact wooden workbench, chunky bolts, gears, and a child-sized screwdriver. The 10-piece kit uses smooth, rounded solid wood components finished with non-toxic, water-based paint. Toddlers can turn the bolts into the bench top, spin the gears, or take the pieces apart and start again, practicing grip and hand-eye coordination along the way. The bench measures 8 inches across and stores its pieces in a shallow tray. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Lantern Bug Circuitry Starter Set
description: Build a tiny circuit-powered firefly that blinks when its wings are pressed. The kit contains a snap-together plastic body, LED module, battery holder, switch, insulated wires, and a child-friendly illustrated guide to open and closed circuits. No soldering is required: components click into labeled sockets, making it easy to rebuild and test different connections. A coin-cell battery is included, and the finished bug is about 5 inches long. Designed for ages 8 and up, with adult help recommended for setup.

title: Cloud Hopper Foam Rocket Launcher
description: Send soft foam rockets soaring with a foot-pump launcher built for backyard experiments and active play. The set includes a stable launch base, flexible air tube, three lightweight foam rockets, and an angle guide for comparing different launch paths. Kids can adjust the launcher position, count steps to estimate distance, and take turns aiming for open lawn targets. The pump requires no batteries and folds down for storage. Use outdoors in a clear area, away from people and windows; recommended for ages 6 and up.

title: Pebble Path Wooden Push-and-Roll Buggy
description: A first push toy for little walkers, this sturdy wooden buggy rolls on four smooth wheels and carries a friendly beetle passenger. The 8-inch-long beechwood body has rounded edges, water-based color accents, and a short handle sized for small hands. Children can push it along the floor or lift out the beetle for simple pretend play. Designed for ages 12 months and up; wipe clean with a damp cloth. Adult supervision is recommended during play.

title: Marsh Habitat: Build a Miniature Food Web
description: Explore how plants, insects, amphibians, and birds depend on one another with this hands-on ecology kit. It includes a 10-inch foldout marsh board, 18 illustrated species tiles, reusable linking cords, and a 24-page activity booklet with observation prompts and food-web challenges. Kids arrange the habitat, trace energy through the ecosystem, and try scenario cards that change the balance of species. Recommended for ages 8 and up. No live specimens or electronic parts are included.

title: Museum After Hours: A Cooperative Art Heist Game
description: Work together to guide a crew through a quiet museum, collect the assigned artifacts, and reach the exit before the night guard completes a patrol. This cooperative board game includes a modular 20-room board, four wooden character pieces, 60 cards, tokens, and a rulebook. Variable guard routes make each 30-minute game feel different, while three difficulty levels suit new and experienced players. For 2–4 players ages 10 and up; no app is required.

title: Juniper the Sleepy Snow Leopard Plush
description: Juniper is a soft snow leopard companion with cream-colored plush, charcoal rosette spots, embroidered eyes, and a gently weighted lower body for a cozy feel in a lap or reading nook. The plush measures 11 inches from nose to tail and is made with polyester fabric and recycled polyester fill. Its flexible tail and stitched paws invite gentle imaginative play. Suitable for ages 3 and up; surface clean with a damp cloth and mild soap.

title: Colorful Creature Clay Charms Studio
description: Make a collection of small, colorful charms with this beginner-friendly air-dry clay set. The kit contains six 1-ounce clay colors, two shaping tools, a texture roller, a reusable work mat, jump rings, and illustrated instructions for creating animal faces and tiny food designs. Finished pieces dry naturally and can be attached to key rings or used as desk decorations; hardware is included for five charms. Recommended for ages 8 and up. Clay is not intended for eating.

title: Meadow Kite with Tail-Ribbon Refill Set
description: Take to an open field with a lightweight diamond kite designed for easy handling in a steady breeze. The 24-inch frame uses flexible fiberglass spars and a ripstop polyester sail, with a 120-foot line reel and a detachable ribbon tail for added color in the sky. A printed setup guide covers assembly, safe launching, and basic wind checks. For outdoor use with adult supervision; choose an open area away from roads, trees, and power lines. Recommended for ages 6 and up.

title: Tiny Terrariums: 100-Piece Garden Puzzle
description: Piece together a bright cross-section of tiny glass gardens, complete with miniature ferns, stones, mushrooms, and hand tools. The 100-piece puzzle measures 15 by 11 inches when assembled and comes in a compact paperboard box with a full-color reference image. Large, sturdy pieces are easy to sort and handle for younger puzzlers, while the detailed illustration offers plenty to notice as the scene comes together. Recommended for ages 5 and up; made from recycled cardboard.

title: Pocket Weather Station: Wind and Rain Explorer
description: Build simple instruments for keeping track of changing weather with this tabletop-and-garden science kit. It includes a plastic rain gauge, a snap-together wind vane, a reusable observation chart, a compass card, and a 32-page guide to clouds, wind direction, and rainfall. Kids can record daily readings and compare results over a week or a season. Recommended for ages 8 and up. The kit is designed for supervised outdoor use and does not include batteries or electronic sensors.

title: Pocket Arcade: Handheld Pixel Puzzle Console
description: This pocket-sized handheld console offers a collection of built-in logic and pattern games on a clear 2.4-inch color screen. It features a directional pad, four action buttons, adjustable volume, and a rechargeable battery with a USB-C charging cable included. The lightweight shell measures about 5 inches long, making it easy to pack for travel or quiet downtime. Games are self-contained, with no Wi-Fi connection or account needed. Recommended for ages 8 and up; charge with adult supervision.

title: Build a Backyard Bird Feeder Workshop
description: Assemble a simple hanging feeder and begin watching neighborhood birds from a window, porch, or garden. The kit includes pre-cut pine pieces, child-safe water-based paint, a paintbrush, a hanging cord, and step-by-step illustrated instructions. Once assembled and decorated, the feeder measures approximately 8 inches tall and has a removable base for easy cleaning. Birdseed is not included. Recommended for ages 7 and up with adult help for assembly; place the finished feeder where it can be checked and cleaned regularly.

title: Kitchen Chemistry: Color-Changing Cabbage Lab
description: Explore acids and bases with a hands-on kitchen chemistry kit built around red cabbage indicator. The box includes test tubes, a reusable pipette, sample cups, a color chart, safety goggles, and illustrated experiment cards; common household liquids supply the test samples. Young scientists can compare color changes, record results, and try a guided mystery-liquid challenge. Designed for ages 8 and up, with adult help recommended for setup and cleanup. No batteries required.

title: Lanterns at Low Tide: A Coastal Tile Game
description: In this breezy strategy game, players place tidepool tiles to guide tiny lantern crabs toward safe nesting coves. The box contains 72 illustrated tiles, four wooden crab tokens, a tide marker, and a quick-start guide. Choose a family-friendly shared goal or compete to build the most connected shoreline before the tide turns. Games take about 25 minutes and suit two to four players ages 7 and up. The compact box stores easily on a shelf or packs for a weekend away.

title: Pip the Patchwork Thundercloud Plush
description: Pip is a soft, huggable cloud with a cheerful stitched lightning-bolt patch and a gently weighted base for sitting on a bed or desk. Made from short-pile recycled polyester fabric with embroidered facial details, this plush measures about 10 inches tall. Its squishy shape makes it a cozy companion for reading, travel, or imaginative weather stories. Surface clean with a damp cloth and mild soap; not intended for children under 3 because of small decorative details.

title: Recycled Paper Marble Maze Art Kit
description: Design, decorate, and play with a tabletop maze made from sturdy recycled paperboard. The kit includes pre-cut maze walls, a fold-up base, two glass marbles, washable markers, and illustrated prompts for adding bridges, dead ends, and secret routes. Kids can color the pieces before assembling the maze, then redesign the layout whenever they want a new challenge. Suitable for ages 6 and up; adult help may be useful for the first assembly. Finished maze measures approximately 9 by 9 inches.

title: Trailblazer Junior Binoculars with Neck Strap
description: Give young nature watchers a lightweight pair of binoculars for backyard birding, park walks, and family camping trips. The durable ABS body has soft rubber eyecups, a central focus wheel, and 4x magnification suited to nearby wildlife and scenery. A breakaway neck strap and drawstring storage pouch are included. The binoculars measure about 4 inches across and fit comfortably in smaller hands. Recommended for ages 6 and up; they are for play and observation, not a substitute for protective eyewear.

title: The Night Market Cat: 500-Piece Puzzle
description: Piece together a lively evening market filled with paper lanterns, noodle stalls, and a curious cat weaving between shoppers. This 500-piece jigsaw is printed on thick recycled board with a matte finish to reduce glare, and it includes a full-color reference poster. The completed image measures 18 by 24 inches, making it a satisfying project for a quiet afternoon or a shared family table. Recommended for ages 10 and up. Store pieces in the resealable bag between sessions.

title: Pocket Pixel Pet: Rechargeable Clip-On Light
description: Add a playful glow to backpacks and reading corners with this pixel-style clip-on light. Its small LCD face cycles through eight simple expressions, while the warm-white LED provides a handy low-level light for a desk or bedside shelf. The rechargeable lithium battery powers the light through a USB-C port; a short charging cable is included. A sturdy clip attaches to a bag strap or pencil pouch, and the light is about 3 inches tall. For ages 8 and up; charge under adult supervision.

title: Woodland Animal Finger-Puppet Theater Set
description: Turn story time into a little forest performance with five soft finger puppets: a fox, owl, rabbit, bear, and hedgehog. Each puppet is sewn from cotton-blend felt with embroidered features and a roomy opening sized for a child or adult finger. The set comes in a drawstring cotton storage bag that doubles as a simple backdrop for imaginative play. Puppets are approximately 4 inches tall. Recommended for ages 3 and up; spot clean gently and allow to air dry.

title: Replacement Wooden Score Pegs for Campfire Trails
description: Keep your Campfire Trails game ready for the next round with this replacement set of six wooden score pegs. The pegs are turned from unfinished birch and color-coded in red, blue, green, yellow, orange, and purple to match the original game board. Each measures approximately 1 inch long and fits the standard score-track holes. This listing contains spare components only; it does not include the board game, cards, or storage box. A practical repair item for game owners rather than a complete play set.

title: AA Alkaline Batteries, 4-Pack
description: A straightforward four-pack of AA alkaline batteries for compatible toys, controllers, and household devices. Each battery is labeled for easy sorting and arrives in recyclable paperboard packaging. Use them in products that specify standard AA cells, and follow the device maker’s instructions when inserting or replacing batteries. These are single-use batteries, not rechargeable cells. Keep unused batteries in their package and store them in a cool, dry place away from small children. This listing contains batteries only; no toy or charger is included.

title: First Garden Wooden Lacing Beads
description: Introduce little hands to colors, shapes, and early threading with a set of chunky wooden garden beads. The 18 beads include flowers, leaves, and friendly bugs, each finished with water-based paint and smooth, rounded edges. Two thick cotton cords with firm tips make lacing easier for toddlers practicing hand-eye coordination. Beads measure about 1.5 inches across and store in a cotton drawstring pouch. Designed for supervised play, this set suits children ages 3 and up.

title: Kitchen Counter Chemistry: Crystal Color Lab
description: Explore crystal growth and color mixing with a hands-on science kit made for curious kids. The kit includes three growing powders, reusable clear cups, a stirring stick, color drops, and an illustrated experiment guide with simple explanations of solutions and evaporation. Make small crystals in several shades, then compare how they form over time. A tray helps keep the work area tidy, and household water is all you need to get started. Recommended for ages 8 and up with adult supervision.

title: Campfire Trails: The Lost Lunchbox
description: Set off on a lighthearted woodland search in this cooperative board game for families. Players work together to follow trail clues, collect snack tokens, and find a missing lunchbox before the camp lantern runs out. The box includes a foldout game board, 60 clue and event cards, wooden pawns, a lantern timer track, and clear instructions. A round takes about 25 minutes, making it easy to fit into a game night or rainy afternoon. Best for 2–4 players ages 7 and up.

title: Nori the Sleepy Axolotl Plush
description: Nori is a squishy axolotl plush with soft pink gills, embroidered sleepy eyes, and a gently weighted belly for a comforting lap companion. The outer fabric is short-pile polyester, with polyester fiber fill and securely stitched details—no hard plastic parts. Nori measures 12 inches from nose to tail, a handy size for beds, reading corners, or travel bags. Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap, then air dry. Suitable for ages 3 and up.

title: Pressed Petal Window Suncatcher Kit
description: Create translucent flower and leaf decorations with this beginner-friendly suncatcher kit. It comes with 12 reusable window frames, colorful tissue sheets, petal-shaped paper pieces, clear adhesive panels, and cotton hanging loops. Children arrange the paper between the panels to make their own botanical designs, then display them in a sunny window. The frames are about 4 inches across and require no paint or drying time. Suitable for ages 6 and up; younger makers may need help with the small pieces.

title: Creekside Splash Pad Sprinkler Mat
description: Turn a warm afternoon into a splashy backyard play session with this round sprinkler mat. Connect the 68-inch PVC mat to a standard garden hose and adjust the water pressure to change the height of the gentle perimeter spray. The shallow center surface gives toddlers room to sit, crawl, or splash under adult supervision. It folds flat for storage and includes a hose adapter and simple setup guide. Use on a level lawn, and empty and dry after each play session.

title: Moonlit Greenhouse 200-Piece Puzzle
description: Piece together a cozy greenhouse scene filled with potted herbs, hanging glass jars, and moonlight shining through tall windows. This 200-piece jigsaw is printed on sturdy recycled board with a matte finish to reduce glare. The completed image measures 15 by 11 inches, and the box includes a full-size reference poster for easy sorting. A good fit for older children and relaxed family puzzle time, it is recommended for ages 8 and up. Store the pieces in the included resealable bag between sessions.

title: Pocket Pixel Weather Station
description: Give budding weather watchers a compact digital station for tracking the conditions at home. The color screen displays indoor and outdoor temperature, humidity, time, and a simple forecast icon from the wireless sensor. Place the sensor near a window or on a sheltered porch, then compare readings in the included observation notebook. The station measures about 5 inches wide and runs on USB power; the sensor uses two AAA batteries, sold separately. Recommended for ages 8 and up.

title: Woodland Acorn Counting Cups
description: Stack, nest, and sort with six sturdy cups inspired by woodland colors. Made from food-grade silicone, the flexible cups have raised dots and simple number marks to encourage sensory exploration and early counting. Each cup has a small drain hole, so the set works for supervised bath play as well as floor play. The cups nest together to save space and range from 2 to 4 inches tall. Rinse clean with warm soapy water and air dry. Suitable from 12 months.

title: Backyard Beetle Habitat Builder
description: Build a simple observation habitat and learn what small garden invertebrates need to stay safe while being studied. This kit includes a ventilated clear container, a removable magnifying lid, a soft brush, a leaf-and-bark habitat card, and a field notebook with drawing prompts. Children can observe a found beetle briefly, record its features, and then release it where it was discovered. No live animal is included. The activity is designed for ages 7 and up with adult guidance outdoors.

title: Little Harbor Wooden Tumble Tower
description: A sturdy first stacking set for curious hands, made from smooth beechwood with water-based color accents. The nine chunky pieces include a low wooden base and graduated rings that are easy for toddlers to grasp and stack. Use it for open-ended building, color naming, or simple turn-taking play. The largest piece measures 5 inches tall, and all pieces fit neatly in the included cotton storage bag. For ages 18 months and up; adult supervision is recommended.

title: Pocket Circuit: Marble-Powered Logic Lab
description: Build a compact marble machine, then experiment with ramps, gates, and levers to guide each run into the target cup. The kit includes 42 reusable plastic track pieces, a hand-crank elevator, 12 glass marbles, and a 24-page illustrated challenge booklet. No batteries or tools are needed for assembly. Try the starter layouts before redesigning the course to solve increasingly tricky paths. Recommended for ages 8 and up; small parts make this unsuitable for children under 3.

title: Candlelight at Foxglove Inn
description: In this cozy deduction game, players work together to discover which guest misplaced the innkeeper’s brass key before the evening bell. Draw clue cards, compare guest schedules, and narrow down possibilities on the shared dry-erase floor plan. The box contains a foldout board, 60 cards, four marker tokens, and a small dry-erase pen. A round takes about 25 minutes for two to five players, ages 10 and up. The simple rules make it a good choice for a family game night.

title: Pipkin the Toasty Acorn Mouse
description: A pocket-sized woodland companion with a warm rust-colored coat, cream belly, and a stitched acorn cap. Pipkin is made from soft polyester plush with embroidered eyes and a small amount of recycled fiber fill. At 8 inches tall, this mouse is easy to tuck into a backpack or keep beside a bedtime book. Surface-clean with a damp cloth and mild soap, then air-dry. Suitable for ages 3 and up; the attached cap is decorative and not removable.

title: Fold-and-Fly Paper Creature Workshop
description: Turn patterned paper into a flock of fluttering creatures with this screen-free folding and decorating set. It includes 30 printed sheets in three weights, 12 peel-and-stick eye pairs, a sheet of reusable shape guides, and a 20-page illustrated instruction booklet. Make simple gliders first, then add folded wings, tails, and paper tabs to change how each one moves. Finished creatures range from 4 to 9 inches across. Recommended for ages 7 and up; scissors are not included.

title: Creekside Splash-and-Score Water Blasters
description: Set up a backyard target course with two easy-pump water blasters and a collapsible scoring target. Each blaster has a 300 ml reservoir, a simple pull-and-release trigger, and a rounded grip sized for older children. The target stands 24 inches high and folds flat for storage; its three fabric pockets score different points. Use on a lawn or patio, refill from a bucket, and let the pieces air-dry after play. Recommended for ages 6 and up. Adult supervision is advised near water.

title: The Clockmaker’s Attic 500-Piece Puzzle
description: Piece together a richly detailed attic workshop filled with brass gears, winding keys, tiny clocks, and shafts of afternoon light. The 500-piece puzzle is printed on sturdy recycled board with a matte finish to reduce glare. Its completed image measures 18 by 24 inches, and the box includes a full-size reference print for sorting and assembly. A satisfying project for solo puzzlers or a relaxed evening with family, recommended for ages 10 and up. Store completed pieces in the included paper bag.

title: Little Orchard Wooden Pull-Along Cart
description: Encourage early walking and pretend play with a compact pull-along cart made from solid rubberwood. Four smooth-rolling wheels and a cotton pull cord make it easy to bring favorite toys from room to room. The open cart bed measures 8 by 5 inches and can carry blocks, plush friends, or a small stack of board books. Finished with child-safe water-based paint in soft sage and apricot, it wipes clean with a damp cloth. Recommended for ages 18 months and up.

title: Pocket Star: Build-a-Planetarium Projector
description: Assemble a tabletop star projector and explore how changing a light source and rotating a disc can create moving night-sky patterns. The kit includes a snap-fit housing, a low-heat LED module, three printed projection discs, a focus ring, and a USB-C power cable. Adjust the angle to cast constellations onto a nearby wall or ceiling in a dim room. No soldering is required, and illustrated steps guide the build. Recommended for ages 9 and up; adult help may be useful during assembly.

title: Wildflower Window Cling Mosaic
description: Create a bright, translucent window scene without glue or permanent paint. This reusable mosaic set has 120 soft vinyl shapes in petal, leaf, and geometric forms, plus a clear 10-by-12-inch layout sheet and four printed design cards. Arrange the pieces on a clean, smooth window, then lift and reposition them to change the pattern. The clings are easy to remove and store flat between projects. Designed for ages 5 and up; adult supervision is recommended for younger children.

title: Backyard Weather Wheelhouse
description: Build a small outdoor weather station and use its instruments to compare changing conditions over several days. The kit includes a rain gauge, wind vane, simple cup anemometer, thermometer, mounting stake, and a weather journal with observation prompts. Assemble the plastic and coated-card components using the included fasteners, then place the station in an open area away from walls and trees. No batteries are required. Recommended for ages 8 and up, with adult assistance for choosing a safe installation spot.

title: First Steps Wooden Rainbow Stacker
description: This chunky wooden stacking toy invites little hands to explore color, size, and balance. Six smooth, water-based-finish arches nest together or stand in a wobbly rainbow tower, with rounded edges designed for supervised toddler play. The largest arch measures 5.5 inches wide, making the pieces easy to grasp and arrange on the floor or a low play table. Made from FSC-certified beechwood, the set includes six arches and a cotton storage bag. Wipe clean with a damp cloth; not intended for mouthing or children under 18 months.

title: Backyard Water Cycle Lab
description: Turn a sunny window into a small-scale lesson in evaporation and condensation with this reusable water cycle experiment kit. Children fill the clear, 9-inch observation chamber, add the included cloud and landscape cards, and record changes in the fold-out activity journal. A clip-on thermometer helps compare chamber and room temperatures, while illustrated prompts guide five simple investigations. The kit contains a chamber, thermometer, cards, journal, and reusable adhesive seals; household water is supplied separately. Designed for ages 8 and up, with an adult helping during setup.

title: Tansy the Teal Sea Turtle Plush
description: Tansy is a soft sea turtle companion with a rounded teal shell, embroidered flipper lines, and a gentle stitched smile. The 12-inch plush is made from recycled polyester velour and filled with resilient recycled fiber, so it sits comfortably on a bed or travels along for quiet play. Its smooth fabric shell and softly padded flippers offer varied textures for little hands to explore. Surface wash with mild soap and air dry. Suitable for ages 3 and up; this plush has embroidered features rather than plastic eyes.

title: Block-Print Tote Bag Craft Set
description: Make a custom library or market tote using washable fabric ink and easy-grip foam printing blocks. The set includes a natural cotton tote measuring 13 by 14 inches, four geometric stamp shapes, a reusable ink tray, two colors of water-based fabric ink, and a practice sheet. Follow the pattern guide or arrange the blocks into an original design, then let the finished bag dry before an adult heat-sets the print according to the instructions. Suitable for ages 8 and up, with supervision recommended for ink handling and heat-setting.

title: Desert Night Sky 250-Piece Puzzle
description: Build a clear, colorful view of the desert after sunset, with a crescent moon, distant mesas, and small animals tucked among the cacti. The 250-piece puzzle is printed on thick recycled board with a matte finish to reduce glare during longer sessions. When complete, the image measures 15 by 11 inches, a convenient size for a kitchen table or puzzle mat. A full-color reference poster and sturdy storage box are included. Designed for ages 8 and up, with pieces sized for comfortable handling by school-age puzzlers.

title: Pocket Rover Remote-Control Buggy
description: Steer this compact rechargeable buggy around chair legs, cardboard ramps, and indoor obstacle courses using the included 2.4 GHz controller. The rover has grippy rubber tires, a front bumper, and two driving speeds to help new drivers get the hang of turns before picking up pace. It measures 6 inches long and recharges through the supplied USB cable; the controller requires two AA batteries, sold separately. A simple illustrated guide covers charging and basic operation. Recommended for ages 8 and up, with best performance on smooth indoor surfaces.

title: Little Lantern Wooden Musical Xylophone
description: Introduce early rhythm and cause-and-effect play with a compact wooden xylophone made for small hands. Eight brightly colored metal bars are secured to a beechwood base, and the included short mallet has a rounded wooden handle that is easy to grip. The instrument measures 9 inches long and produces clear, distinct notes for tapping along to songs or exploring sound freely. A soft cotton drawstring bag keeps the mallet with the xylophone between play sessions. Intended for ages 3 and up; adult supervision is recommended during use.

title: Build-a-Bridge Engineering Challenge
description: Explore how shape and support affect strength with a build-and-test bridge kit for curious young engineers. The box includes 36 reusable wooden beams, connector clips, a 12-inch test span, and a set of illustrated challenge cards ranging from a simple beam bridge to a truss design. Build across the included supports, then add the supplied weight disks one at a time to compare results and record observations. No glue or batteries are needed, so designs can be taken apart and rebuilt. Recommended for ages 9 and up; small clips require adult supervision.

title: Moon Garden Watercolor Postcard Kit
description: Paint a set of illustrated moon-garden postcards with a beginner-friendly watercolor kit made for creative evenings or rainy afternoons. It includes 12 heavyweight postcards, six watercolor pans, a size 4 brush, a mixing card, and a small guide to layering color and adding simple washes. The postcard fronts feature light printed outlines of flowers, moths, and crescent moons, while the backs are blank for messages and mailing addresses. Finished cards measure 4 by 6 inches. Recommended for ages 7 and up; protect clothing and surfaces while painting.

title: Tidepool Tummy-Time Mirror & Crinkle Mat
description: Make early floor play inviting with a padded tummy-time mat featuring a baby-safe mirror, soft crinkle panel, and two detachable fabric toys. The quilted surface combines cotton canvas with a polyester fill and measures 30 by 30 inches, giving little ones room to stretch and explore. High-contrast sea-life shapes encourage looking and reaching, while the toys attach with fabric loops for easy repositioning. Spot clean with a damp cloth; remove the toys before washing the mat according to its care label.

title: Pocket Volcano Field Lab
description: Build a layered tabletop volcano and investigate how changing the mixture affects its bubbly eruption. The kit includes a reusable plastic crater, molded landscape base, measuring cup, pipette, safety goggles, and illustrated experiment cards for several kid-friendly trials. Add common household baking soda, vinegar, and washable color to get started. The assembled model is about 8 inches tall and can be rinsed and reused after each experiment. Adult supervision is recommended for setup and cleanup.

title: Mailbox Mix-Up: A Neighborhood Delivery Game
description: Race around a cheerful neighborhood delivering letters to the right homes before the evening bell. Players draw route cards, collect matching colored mail, and choose whether to take a quick detour or risk a shortcut. The game includes a folding board, 60 letter tiles, four wooden mail carriers, route cards, and a simple rulebook. Designed for two to four players ages six and up, a round usually takes about 25 minutes. The sturdy box stores all pieces between family game nights.

title: Bramble the Little Hedgehog Plush
description: A palm-sized woodland friend with a velvety face, soft brown plush body, and embroidered nose, Bramble is made for quiet story time and pocket-sized adventures. The hedgehog measures 8 inches from nose to rump and has lightly textured fabric accents along the back. Its bean-free, machine-stitched construction makes it easy to carry in a backpack or keep on a bedside shelf. Surface wash gently with a damp cloth and air dry. Suitable for children ages three and up.

title: Color Lab: Marbled Paper & Bookmark Set
description: Create flowing marbled patterns on heavyweight paper, then turn favorite prints into bookmarks or small cards. The set contains 20 sheets of absorbent paper, six washable liquid colors, a reusable mixing tray, two pattern combs, bookmark blanks, and instructions for three techniques. Colors are designed to float on a prepared water surface; a shallow basin and paper towels are not included. Finished sheets vary naturally, so each project has its own pattern. Recommended for ages eight and up with adult help during setup.

title: Backyard Ring Toss Garden Stakes
description: Turn a patch of grass into a simple target game with five colorful wooden stakes and four soft rope rings. Set the stakes at different distances to make an easy course for younger players or a trickier challenge for older kids. The stakes stand about 12 inches tall and press into firm soil; the rings have a 6-inch diameter and flexible cotton-wrapped cores. A drawstring storage bag keeps the set together after play. Use outdoors on level ground, away from walkways and breakable items.

title: Mountain Tramway 150-Piece Glow Puzzle
description: Piece together a winding mountain tramway at dusk in this 150-piece puzzle, illustrated with cabins, pine trees, and a starry ridge. A few printed details glow softly after exposure to light, adding a small discovery once the image is complete. The puzzle measures 18 by 12 inches when assembled and comes in a compact box with a full-color reference image. Large, sturdy pieces are easy for younger puzzlers to handle. Intended for ages six and up; glow effect works best after bright indoor light exposure.

title: Clip-On Junior Digital Microscope
description: Explore leaf veins, fabric, and other everyday textures with a compact digital microscope that clips onto many smartphones. The adjustable lens offers magnification up to 60x, with a built-in LED to brighten close-up views. A focus wheel and included calibration card help beginners practice before photographing specimens. The kit includes the microscope, clip adapter, protective pouch, and a short activity guide; phone is not included. Designed for ages eight and up, it runs on two AAA batteries, sold separately.

title: Soft-Edge Foam Boomerang Trio
description: Practice gentle throws with three lightweight foam boomerangs in different shapes, each designed for open spaces and beginner-friendly play. The flexible foam construction has rounded edges and bright colors that are easier to spot on grass. Each boomerang measures about 10 inches across and comes with a simple illustrated guide showing grip and throw direction. Start with short throws in a clear, level area and keep plenty of space between players. Recommended for ages eight and up; not intended for indoor use or windy conditions.

title: Replacement Wooden Wagon Wheels, Set of Four
description: A practical replacement set for a well-loved toy wagon, this pack contains four smooth, unfinished beechwood wheels with center holes sized for compatible 6 mm axles. Each wheel measures 2.5 inches in diameter and is sanded for a clean fit. Use them to repair a wooden pull toy or keep as spare parts for a workshop project. Axles and hardware are not included, and compatibility should be checked before ordering. Adult installation is recommended; keep small components away from children under three.

title: Little Lighthouse Wooden Shape Sorter
description: This sturdy shape sorter gives little hands a simple way to practice matching and grasping. The lighthouse-shaped base is made from smooth, FSC-certified beechwood with water-based paint, and the four chunky pieces—a star, circle, boat, and cloud—are sized for easy handling. Lift the removable roof to retrieve the pieces and start again. Measures 6 inches tall and 5 inches across. Designed for toddlers ages 18 months and up; adult supervision is recommended during play.

title: Pocket Solar Oven Science Kit
description: Explore how sunlight can warm a simple snack with this hands-on solar oven kit. Build the 10-by-10-inch cooker from a reusable corrugated board frame, reflective panels, and a clear heat-trapping cover, then use the included thermometer strip to track temperature changes. The illustrated guide introduces reflection, insulation, and energy transfer through short outdoor experiments. Includes assembly parts, thermometer strip, and activity booklet; food is not included. Best for ages 8 and up, with adult help for assembly and outdoor use.

title: Signal Station: A Cooperative Rescue Game
description: Work together to guide a mountain rescue team through changing weather and winding trail routes. Players share clues, manage a limited supply of signal tokens, and choose when to reroute before the storm deck closes paths on the map. The game includes a folding board, 4 wooden team markers, 60 cards, and 24 tokens, with a typical play time of 25–35 minutes for 2–5 players. Recommended for ages 8 and up, it offers a friendly introduction to cooperative planning and shared decision-making.

title: Clover the Corduroy Garden Snail Plush
description: Clover is a soft, slow-moving garden companion with a rounded shell and a gentle embroidered smile. The shell and body are sewn from cotton-blend corduroy and brushed fabric, with a recycled polyester fill and embroidered facial details. At 9 inches long, this snail is easy to tuck into a backpack or settle beside a pillow. Surface-clean with a damp cloth and mild soap, then air-dry. Suitable for ages 3 and up; not intended for children under 3 because of small fabric details.

title: Make-a-Mini Felt Woodland Crown Kit
description: Turn a strip of soft felt into a woodland-inspired crown decorated with leaves, berries, and a tiny owl. The kit includes pre-cut felt shapes, a flexible adjustable band, peel-and-stick fabric dots, and a picture-led instruction sheet, so no sewing is needed. The finished crown measures up to 22 inches around and can be rearranged for different designs. A good rainy-day project for children ages 6 and up; younger makers can join in with an adult. Scissors are not included.

title: Fold-Out Backyard Badminton Set
description: Set up a casual backyard rally with a portable net that folds into its own carry case. The kit includes two lightweight steel-frame rackets, three nylon shuttlecocks, ground stakes, and a net that adjusts from 8 to 12 feet wide. A quick-lock support system makes setup straightforward on grass or firm soil, and the packed case measures 25 inches long for storage between games. Designed for recreational play by ages 8 and up. Adult setup is recommended, and the set should be stored indoors after use.

title: Coral Reef Layers 180-Piece Puzzle
description: Piece together a bright cutaway view of a coral reef, from sunlit water at the surface to the caves and ledges below. The 180 thick recycled-cardboard pieces have a matte finish that helps reduce glare and are printed with a detailed illustration of reef fish, sea fans, and a passing turtle. Finished size is 15 by 11 inches, a manageable challenge for solo puzzling or family teamwork. The box includes a full-size reference image and a short guide to the habitats shown. Recommended for ages 7 and up.

title: Pocket Synth Explorer: Modular Sound Builder
description: Make rhythmic loops and experiment with electronic sound using a compact, rechargeable synth pad. Eight pressure-sensitive pads trigger tones and percussion, while three slider controls adjust tempo, pitch, and effects. The built-in speaker supports headphone output, and a simple record-and-loop function lets players layer up to four short parts. Includes a USB-C charging cable and a fold-out quick-start guide; headphones are sold separately. The device measures 6 inches wide and is suited to curious music makers ages 10 and up.

title: Baby’s First Woodland Texture Blocks
description: These soft-sided blocks invite babies to squeeze, stack, and explore contrasting textures. The set of six lightweight blocks combines cotton canvas, plush, and crinkle fabric, with stitched woodland shapes and simple high-contrast patterns on each side. Each block measures about 3 inches and contains a gentle rattle or crinkle layer for sensory play. Machine-wash on a gentle cycle inside a laundry bag and air-dry fully. Designed for babies from 6 months, with embroidered details rather than buttons or plastic add-ons.

title: Build-a-Botanical Pressed Flower Bookmark Set
description: Create a set of keepsake bookmarks using translucent paper, botanical illustrations, and pressed-flower-style details. This kit includes six sturdy bookmark blanks, dried flower pieces, clear adhesive sheets, tassel cords, and a small placement tool for arranging each design. Finished bookmarks measure 2 by 6 inches and can be made without paint or drying time. The illustrated guide suggests layouts while leaving room for personal designs. Recommended for ages 8 and up; an adult should help younger crafters handle the small botanical pieces.

title: Junior Trail Radio Duo
description: Keep a pair of explorers in touch on neighborhood walks and campsite adventures with these simple two-way radios. Each unit has a push-to-talk button, a belt clip, and a clear LCD channel display, with 22 channels and a built-in flashlight for low-light situations. The compact radios are made from impact-resistant plastic and measure 5 inches tall. Includes two radios and a quick-start sheet; three AAA batteries per radio are required and sold separately. Intended for ages 8 and up, with an adult nearby during outdoor use.

title: First Forest Wooden Shape-and-Stack Tree
description: This sturdy wooden tree invites little hands to stack chunky woodland shapes and explore simple matching play. The set includes a 22 cm tree-shaped base and six smooth pieces featuring a fox, owl, mushroom, leaf, acorn, and bird. Rounded edges and water-based colors make it comfortable for supervised play, while the pieces store neatly around the base. Toddlers can practice grasping, sorting, and recognizing familiar forest forms at their own pace. Wipe clean with a damp cloth; intended for children ages 18 months and up.

title: Magnet Maze: Arctic Research Station
description: Explore magnetic force by guiding steel beads through a printed Arctic research station maze using a wand beneath the board. The kit includes a sealed 24 cm maze board, magnetic wand, experiment cards, and a short illustrated guide with challenges about attraction, repulsion, and route planning. Children can test how distance and barriers affect the bead’s movement, then design their own paths on the included dry-erase activity sheet. No loose magnets are included. Recommended for ages 7 and up, with adult help for younger experimenters.

title: Raccoon’s Rainy-Day Rescue
description: Work together to help a curious raccoon gather picnic supplies before the rain reaches the park. Players take turns moving along a colorful path, collecting item cards and using weather tokens to plan a safe route back to the den. The cooperative game includes a folding board, 60 cards, 20 wooden tokens, and a simple rulebook for two to four players. A typical round takes about 20 minutes, making it a friendly choice for family game night. Recommended for ages 5 and up.

title: Miso the Midnight Bakery Bunny
description: Miso is a soft, floppy-eared bunny dressed for an imaginary overnight baking shift. Made from short-pile recycled polyester plush with embroidered facial details, this 28 cm companion wears a removable-look apron that is securely stitched in place. Its gently weighted paws help it sit on a bedside shelf or ride along in a backpack. The plush filling is polyester, and the care label recommends surface cleaning with a damp cloth. Suitable for cuddles and pretend play for children ages 3 and up.

title: Folded Worlds: Pop-Up Paper City Studio
description: Build a small paper city with layered buildings, tiny shop signs, and fold-out street details. This craft set contains 18 pre-cut cardstock sheets, 12 patterned papers, adhesive dots, a blunt-tip scoring tool, and illustrated instructions for assembling six connected structures. Kids can color the blank façades, arrange the buildings into different neighborhoods, and add their own paper people and signs. The finished city spans roughly 40 cm when laid out. Recommended for ages 8 and up; scissors are not required.

title: Sprout & Splash Junior Garden Watering Set
description: Make outdoor watering a small-kid-sized job with this lightweight garden set. It includes a 1.2-liter watering can, a hand trowel, a three-piece plant marker set, and a canvas carry pouch with a washable lining. The watering can has a broad handle and gentle-pour spout for tending patio pots, raised beds, or a pretend garden. Tools are made from durable polypropylene with rounded edges. Designed for supervised outdoor play, this set suits children ages 4 and up and stores easily in a garden shed.

title: Dinosaur Dig Site: 120-Piece Layered Puzzle
description: Assemble a colorful excavation scene, then lift the removable puzzle layers to reveal fossil bones beneath the soil. The set includes 120 sturdy cardboard pieces, a 25-piece skeleton overlay, and a fold-out reference sheet identifying the illustrated dinosaur parts. When complete, the main scene measures 45 by 30 cm. Large, varied shapes make it approachable for young puzzle fans while the layered reveal adds a second activity after assembly. Recommended for ages 6 and up; store all pieces in the included paperboard box.

title: Pocket Sound Lab: Record-and-Remix Pad
description: Record short sounds, layer simple rhythms, and experiment with effects using a compact tabletop sound pad. It features eight backlit pads, a built-in microphone, speaker, headphone jack, and 16 preset sound effects. Kids can save up to 30 short recordings in onboard memory and play them back in different sequences. The unit measures 18 cm across and runs on three AA batteries, sold separately. A quick-start booklet introduces recording and remixing without requiring an app. Recommended for ages 8 and up.

title: Little Orchard Wooden Balance Buddies
description: Stack apples, pears, and friendly orchard animals on the curved wooden base without tipping the tree. This balancing set includes a 20 cm base and 12 chunky pieces made from responsibly sourced beechwood, finished with smooth edges and non-toxic water-based paint. Pieces can be balanced freely or sorted by fruit and animal shapes for a simpler activity. It supports early coordination and turn-taking during play with a grown-up. Recommended for ages 2 and up; wipe clean and keep away from prolonged moisture.

title: Glow Garden: Solar-Powered Bug House Kit
description: Build a small illuminated bug house and learn how a solar panel can power a low-voltage LED. The kit includes a pre-cut wooden frame, clear window panels, a miniature solar module, LED light, connecting wires, and illustrated assembly and observation cards. Once assembled, the house can hold leaves and garden finds for short, supervised observations, then be emptied and cleaned between uses. It works best in direct sunlight and requires no batteries. Recommended for ages 9 and up; an adult should assist with wiring and assembly.

title: Cloudberry Loom: Friendship Bracelet Craft Box
description: Make colorful braided and woven friendship bracelets with a compact reusable loom and a cheerful assortment of threads. The box contains a 15 cm cardboard loom, 18 skeins of embroidery floss, 24 letter and color beads, a blunt plastic needle, and step-by-step pattern cards for six designs. Kids can adjust bracelet length by changing the thread spacing or combine colors to create their own patterns. Finished bracelets make easy handmade gifts for friends and family. Recommended for ages 7 and up, with adult help for threading beads.

title: Pebble Path Wooden Push-and-Roll Trolley
description: A sturdy wooden push toy made for little hands learning to move and explore. The rounded trolley has a beechwood frame, smooth water-based finish, and four quiet rubber-rimmed wheels that roll easily across indoor floors. Its low handle is sized for early walkers, while the open body carries a few favorite blocks or small plush friends. Measures 8.5 inches long and 6 inches tall. Use on a flat surface with adult supervision; suitable for children 18 months and up.

title: Solar Rover: Build-and-Test STEM Kit
description: Build a small rover that runs on sunlight, then experiment with its gear layout and wheel traction. The kit includes a solar panel, motor, molded chassis, four wheels, gears, fasteners, and an illustrated guide with six design challenges. No batteries are needed for outdoor testing in direct sun; a bright desk lamp can also power the panel for indoor demonstrations. Finished rover measures about 7 inches long. Recommended for ages 8 and up, with adult help for assembly.

title: Moonbase Market: A Resource-Trading Board Game
