description: Players run tiny supply stalls on a lunar outpost, trading oxygen, seed packets, and repair parts to complete mission orders. Each round brings a shared market event, so plans can shift as resources become scarce or newly available. The box includes a modular board, 96 resource tokens, 48 order cards, player boards, and a rulebook. Plays in about 35 minutes for two to four players, ages 10 and up. A compact strategy game for family nights or teen game groups.

title: Puddle the Green Rainboot Frog Plush
description: Puddle is a soft frog plush dressed for a drizzly day, with stitched rainboot details and a gently weighted base for sitting on a shelf or bed. The velour body is made from polyester fabric with embroidered eyes and a small cotton scarf; there are no hard plastic accessories. It measures 10 inches from toe to crown and is suitable for cuddling or imaginative play. Surface clean with a damp cloth and mild soap. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Print-a-Planet Foam Stamp Workshop
description: Make repeat-pattern prints with a set of easy-grip foam stamps shaped like moons, rings, stars, and orbit paths. The box contains eight reusable stamps, four washable ink pads, a 12-sheet paper pad, and a simple project booklet with ideas for greeting cards and room signs. Stamps are sized for children’s hands and work best on smooth paper or cardstock. Ink washes from skin with soap and water. Recommended for ages 5 and up; protect clothing and work surfaces.

title: Creekside Balance Disc Adventure Set
description: Turn a patch of lawn or a playroom floor into a wobbly stepping trail with six textured balance discs and two connecting rope bridges. The durable, weather-resistant plastic discs have non-slip raised patterns and can be arranged in changing paths for balance games or obstacle courses. Each disc measures 11 inches across; the set supports up to 175 pounds per disc on a level surface. Store indoors when not in use. Recommended for ages 5 and up with adult supervision.

title: City Garden Windows: 300-Piece Puzzle
description: Piece together a lively illustration of balcony gardens, fire escapes, and bright apartment windows at golden hour. This 300-piece puzzle is printed on thick recycled board with a matte finish that helps reduce glare and gives pieces a satisfying fit. Finished size is 18 by 12 inches, and the box includes a full-color reference poster. A good weekend project for older children, teens, or adults who enjoy detailed scenes without a huge piece count. Recommended for ages 8 and up.

title: Pocket Music Mixer: Loop-and-Layer Sound Pad
description: Create short musical loops with a pocket-size sound pad designed for experimenting, not complicated setup. It has 16 pressure-sensitive pads, built-in drum and melody sounds, a small speaker, headphone output, and a record button for layering up to four tracks. The rechargeable battery provides up to five hours of play and charges by the included USB-C cable. Measures 5.5 inches across and fits easily in a backpack. Recommended for ages 8 and up; headphones are not included.

title: Little Meadow Wooden Shape-Pull Snail
description: A cheerful pull-along snail with chunky wooden shapes that can be sorted through openings in its removable shell. The body is made from smooth FSC-certified rubberwood with non-toxic, water-based paint, and the cord has a large wooden grip. Its slow-rolling wheels make it easy to follow along during indoor play, while the sorting shapes introduce color matching and simple problem-solving. The snail measures 9 inches long. Suitable for ages 18 months and up; use with adult supervision.

title: Backyard Wind-Powered Spinner Lab
description: Explore wind energy by assembling a small spinner, testing blade shapes, and measuring how much weight the rotor can lift. The kit includes a reusable base, lightweight blades, axle, string spool, paper wind meter, and a 20-page activity guide with observation charts. Try experiments outdoors on a breezy day or use a household fan to compare results. The assembled model stands about 12 inches tall. Recommended for ages 9 and up; scissors and a pencil are useful but not included.

title: Glow Trails: Fluorescent Lacing Art Set
description: Design glowing wall decorations by threading fluorescent cord through sturdy, pre-punched shapes. The set includes six cardboard panels, four colors of soft lacing cord, plastic-tipped threading tools, and a guide with patterns for stars, geometric badges, and freeform designs. Charge the finished pieces under a bright lamp, then display them in a dim room for a gentle afterglow. Panels measure about 6 inches across and can be arranged together or separately. Recommended for ages 7 and up.

title: Little Tidepool Wooden Sensory Discovery Tray
description: Made for curious hands, this compact wooden discovery tray pairs a smooth beechwood frame with three removable sensory pieces: a ridged silicone shell, a soft fabric starfish, and a gently rattling sealed shaker. The tray measures 9 by 7 inches and has rounded edges for comfortable floor play with a caregiver nearby. Babies can explore different textures, practice grasping, and move the pieces between compartments. Wipe the wood with a damp cloth; fabric and silicone pieces clean separately with mild soap.

title: Pocket Wind Tunnel: Paper Glider STEM Lab
description: Explore lift and drag with a tabletop wind tunnel that lets young engineers test their own paper glider designs. The kit includes a hand-crank fan, clear tunnel panels, lightweight paper sheets, reusable clips, a measuring ruler, and an illustrated experiment booklet. Assemble the tunnel on a desk, fold several wing shapes, then compare how far each glider travels in the airflow. The finished unit measures about 12 inches long and requires no batteries. Recommended for ages 8 and up; adult help is useful during assembly.

title: Lanterns Along the Canal: A Tile-Laying Game
description: Build a winding canal town by placing illustrated path and lantern tiles, linking docks, courtyards, and bridges before the evening festival begins. This family strategy game includes 72 sturdy cardboard tiles, four wooden player markers, a cloth tile bag, and a fold-out score track. Two to four players take turns extending the shared map while completing private route goals. A typical game lasts about 30 minutes, with clear rules suited to players ages 10 and up. The box measures 10 by 10 inches for easy shelf storage.

title: Little Comet Wooden Rolling Rattle
description: A smooth wooden rattle sized for little hands, with a rolling shape that invites grasping, shaking, and gentle floor play. The body is made from solid beechwood with water-based, child-safe finishes, and its enclosed beads make a soft, lively sound when moved. Measures 4 inches long and is easy to wipe clean with a damp cloth. Designed for supervised play from 6 months; inspect regularly and discontinue use if damaged.
